bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 資治通鑑第156卷

translations.literal: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 156
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 156

sentences.zh: 【梁紀十二】起昭陽赤奮若，盡閼逢攝提格，凡二年。

translations.literal: [Liang Records 12] From Zhaoyang Chifenruo through Efeng Shetige; two years in all.
translations.idiomatic: [Liang Records 12] The cycle runs from Zhaoyang Chifenruo through Efeng Shetige; two years in all.

sentences.zh: 1春正月辛卯，上祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on xinmao, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Altar and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on xinmao, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Altar and proclaimed a general amnesty, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 2魏竇泰奄至爾朱兆庭，軍人因宴休惰，忽見泰軍，驚走；

translations.literal: Wei's Dou Tai suddenly reached Erzhu Zhao's encampment. The army, feasting and resting in idleness, was startled at the sight of Tai's troops and fled in panic;
translations.idiomatic: Dou Tai of Wei suddenly appeared at Erzhu Zhao's encampment. The soldiers had been feasting and resting in idleness; at the sudden sight of Tai's army they fled in panic;

sentences.zh: 追破之於赤谼嶺，眾並降散。

translations.literal: pursuing and defeating them at Chihong Ridge, where the host all surrendered and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Tai pursued and defeated them at Chihong Ridge, and the whole host surrendered and scattered.

sentences.zh: 兆逃於窮山，命左右西河張亮及蒼頭陳山提斬己首以降，皆不忍；

translations.literal: Zhao fled to a remote mountain and ordered his attendants Zhang Liang of Xihe and the groom Chen Shanti to cut off his head to surrender; none could bear to do it;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao fled into the wild hills and ordered his attendants Zhang Liang of Xihe and the groom Chen Shanti to cut off his head so they could surrender; none could bring themselves to do it;

sentences.zh: 兆乃殺所乘白馬，自縊於樹。

translations.literal: Zhao then killed the white horse he rode and hanged himself from a tree.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao then killed the white horse he had been riding and hanged himself from a tree.

sentences.zh: 歡親臨，厚葬之。

translations.literal: Huan came in person and gave him a lavish burial.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan came in person and gave him a lavish burial.

sentences.zh: 慕容紹宗攜爾朱榮妻子及兆餘眾詣歡降，歡以義故，待之甚厚。

translations.literal: Murong Shaozong brought Erzhu Rong's wife and children and Zhao's remaining followers to surrender to Huan; because of past ties of righteousness, Huan treated them very generously.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Shaozong brought Erzhu Rong's wife and children and Zhao's remaining followers to surrender to Huan; out of past ties of righteousness, Huan treated them very generously.

sentences.zh: 兆之在秀容，左右皆密通款於歡，唯張亮無啟疏。

translations.literal: While Zhao was at Xiurong, all those around him had secretly opened communications with Huan; only Zhang Liang sent no letters.
translations.idiomatic: While Zhao was at Xiurong, everyone around him had secretly opened communications with Huan; only Zhang Liang sent no letters.

sentences.zh: 歡嘉之，以為丞相府參軍。

translations.literal: Huan admired this and appointed him Aide in the Chancellor's Office.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan admired this and appointed him Aide in the Chancellor's Office.

sentences.zh: 3魏罷諸行台。

translations.literal: Wei abolished all mobile headquarters (xingtai).
translations.idiomatic: Wei abolished all mobile headquarters (xingtai), the annals record.

sentences.zh: 4辛亥，上祀明堂。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the emperor sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the emperor sacrificed at the Bright Hall, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 5丁巳，魏主追尊其父為武穆帝，太妃馮氏為武穆後，母李氏為皇太妃。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Wei sovereign posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wumu and the consort Lady Feng as Empress Wumu, and his mother Lady Li as Grand Imperial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Wei sovereign posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wumu and the consort Lady Feng as Empress Wumu, and his mother Lady Li as Grand Imperial Consort, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 6營州刺史曹鳳、東荊州刺史雷能勝等舉城降魏。

translations.literal: Cao Feng, inspector of Yingzhou, Lei Nengsheng, inspector of Eastern Jingzhou, and others surrendered their cities to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Feng, inspector of Yingzhou, Lei Nengsheng, inspector of Eastern Jingzhou, and others submitted their cities to Wei.

sentences.zh: 7魏侍中斛斯椿聞喬寧、張子期之死，內不自安，與南陽王寶炬、武衛將軍元毘、王思政密勸魏主圖丞相歡。

translations.literal: Wei's Palace Attendant Husu Chun, hearing of the deaths of Qiao Ning and Zhang Ziqi, was ill at ease within himself. With the Prince of Nanyang, Bao Ju, Military Guard General Yuan Pi, and Wang Sizheng he secretly urged the Wei sovereign to plot against Chancellor Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's Palace Attendant Husu Chun, hearing of the deaths of Qiao Ning and Zhang Ziqi, was ill at ease. With the Prince of Nanyang, Bao Ju, Military Guard General Yuan Pi, and Wang Sizheng he secretly urged the Wei sovereign to plot against Chancellor Huan.

sentences.zh: 毘，遵之玄孫也。

translations.literal: Pi was a great-grandson of Zun.
translations.idiomatic: Pi was a great-grandson of Zun, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 舍人元士弼又言歡受詔不敬，帝由是不悅。

translations.literal: Gentleman of the Palace Yuan Shibi also said that Huan was disrespectful in receiving the edicts, and because of this the emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of the Palace Yuan Shibi also said that Huan was disrespectful in receiving the edicts, and since of this the emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 椿勸帝置閣內都督部曲，又增武直人數，自直閣已下，員別數百，皆選四方驍勇者充之。

translations.literal: Chun urged the emperor to establish an inner-guard command with its own troops, and also to increase the number of martial attendants; from Direct Attendant downward, several hundred posts were set apart, all filled by fierce warriors chosen from all quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Chun urged the emperor to establish an inner-guard command with its own troops, and also to increase the number of martial attendants; from Direct Attendant downward, several hundred posts were set apart, all filled by fierce warriors chosen from all quarters, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 帝數出遊幸，椿自部勒，別為行陳，由是朝政、軍謀，帝專與椿決之。

translations.literal: The emperor often went out on tours and hunts; Chun personally arrayed them in separate formations, so that court affairs and military plans were decided solely between the emperor and Chun.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign often went out on tours and hunts; Chun personally arrayed them in separate formations, so that court affairs and military plans were decided solely between the emperor and Chun.

sentences.zh: 帝以關中大行台賀拔岳擁重兵，密與相結，又出侍中賀拔勝為都督三荊等七州諸軍事、荊州刺史，欲倚勝兄弟以敵歡，歡益不悅。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Grand Commissioner of Guanzhong Heba Yue held heavy forces, secretly allied with him; he also sent out Palace Attendant Heba Sheng as Commander-in-Chief of the Military Affairs of the seven provinces of Sanjing and others and inspector of Jingzhou, intending to rely on the Heba brothers to counter Huan—and Huan grew still more displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, since Grand Commissioner of Guanzhong Heba Yue held heavy forces, secretly allied with him; he also dispatched out Palace Attendant Heba Sheng as Commander-in-Chief of the Military Affairs of the seven provinces of Sanjing and others and inspector of Jingzhou, intending to rely on the Heba brothers to counter Huan—and Huan grew still more displeased.

sentences.zh: 8侍中、司空高乾之在信都也，遭父喪，不暇終服。

translations.literal: When Gao Gan had been at Xindu, he met with his father's death and had no leisure to complete mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Gan had been at Xindu, he met with his father's death and had no leisure to complete mourning, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 及孝武帝即位，表請解職行喪，詔聽解侍中，司空如故。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, Gan memorialized asking to leave office to observe mourning; an edict allowed him to resign as Palace Attendant while retaining the post of Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, Gan memorialized asking to leave office to observe mourning; an edict allowed him to resign as Palace Attendant while retaining the post of Minister of Works, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 乾雖求退，不謂遽見許。

translations.literal: Though Gan sought to withdraw, he did not expect to be granted permission so quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Though Gan sought to withdraw, he did not expect to be granted permission so quickly, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 既去內侍，朝政多不關預，居常怏怏。

translations.literal: Once removed from inner attendance, he had little part in court affairs and was often resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Once removed from inner attendance, he had little part in court affairs and was often resentful, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 帝既貳於歡，冀乾為己用，嘗於華林園宴罷，獨留乾，謂之曰：「司空奕世忠良，今日復建殊效，相與雖則君臣，義同兄弟，宜共立盟約，以敦情契。

translations.literal: The emperor, already estranged from Huan, hoped to use Gan for his own ends. Once, when a feast in the Hualin Garden had ended, he kept Gan alone and said to him, "The Minister of Works' house has been loyal for generations; today you have again achieved a singular merit. Though in name we are ruler and subject, in affection we are as brothers. We ought to establish a covenant together to deepen our bond.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, already estranged from Huan, hoped to use Gan for his own ends. Once, when a feast in the Hualin Garden had ended, he kept Gan alone and told him, "The Minister of Works' house has been loyal for generations; today you have again achieved a singular merit. Though in name we are ruler and subject, in affection we are as brothers. We ought to establish a covenant together to deepen our bond.

sentences.zh: 」殷勤逼之。

translations.literal: " He pressed him earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: " He pressed him earnestly, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 乾對曰：「臣以身許國，何敢有貳！

translations.literal: Gan replied, "I have given my person to the state—how dare I be of two minds!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Gan replied, "I have given my person to the state—how dare I be of two minds!

sentences.zh: 」時事出倉猝，且不謂帝有異圖，遂不固辭，亦不以啟歡。

translations.literal: " The affair had arisen in haste, and Gan did not suppose the emperor had another design; he therefore did not firmly refuse, nor did he report it to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: " The affair had arisen in haste, and Gan did not suppose the emperor had another design; he therefore did not firmly refuse, nor did he report it to Huan, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 及帝置部曲，乾乃私謂所親曰：「主上不親勳賢，而招集群小，數遣元士弼、王思政往來關西與賀拔岳計議，又出賀拔勝為荊州，外示疏忌，實欲樹黨，令其兄弟相近，冀據有西方。

translations.literal: When the emperor established his own troops, Gan said privately to those close to him, "The sovereign does not draw near meritorious worthies but gathers petty men about him. He repeatedly sends Yuan Shibi and Wang Sizheng to Guanxi to consult with Heba Yue, and has also sent out Heba Sheng as inspector of Jingzhou—outwardly showing estrangement, in truth building a faction, placing the brothers near each other in hope that they will hold the west.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor established his own troops, Gan said privately to those close to him, "The sovereign does not draw near meritorious worthies but gathers petty men about him. He repeatedly sends Yuan Shibi and Wang Sizheng to Guanxi to consult with Heba Yue, and has also dispatched out Heba Sheng as inspector of Jingzhou—outwardly showing estrangement, in truth building a faction, placing the brothers near each other in hope that they will hold the west.

sentences.zh: 禍難將作，必及於我。

translations.literal: Calamity is about to break out and will surely reach me.
translations.idiomatic: Calamity is about to break out and will surely reach me, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」乃密啟歡。

translations.literal: " He then secretly reported to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: " He then secretly reported to Huan, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歡召乾詣并州，面論時事，乾因勸歡受魏禪。

translations.literal: Huan summoned Gan to Bingzhou and discussed the times face to face; Gan thereupon urged Huan to accept the Wei mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan summoned Gan to Bingzhou and discussed the times face to face; Gan then urged Huan to accept the Wei mandate.

sentences.zh: 歡以袖掩其口曰：「勿妄言！

translations.literal: Huan covered his mouth with his sleeve and said, "Do not speak rashly!
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan covered his mouth with his sleeve and said, "Do not speak rashly!

sentences.zh: 今令司空復為侍中，門下之事一以相委。

translations.literal: I shall now have the Minister of Works restored as Palace Attendant; all matters of the Secretariat shall be entrusted to you.
translations.idiomatic: I shall now have the Minister of Works restored as Palace Attendant; all matters of the Secretariat shall be entrusted to you, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」歡屢啟請，帝不許。

translations.literal: " Huan repeatedly memorialized requesting it, but the emperor would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan repeatedly memorialized requesting it, but the emperor would not agree, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 乾知變難將起，密啟歡求為徐州；

translations.literal: Gan knew that trouble was about to arise and secretly asked Huan for the post of inspector of Xuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Gan knew that trouble was about to arise and secretly asked Huan for the post of inspector of Xuzhou;

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，以乾為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、徐州刺史，以咸陽王坦為司空。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinyou, Gan was made Grand General Who Campaigns on Horseback, Bearer of the Staff with Equal Rank to the Three Dukes, and inspector of Xuzhou; the Prince of Xianyang, Tan, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou, Gan became Grand General Who Campaigns on Horseback, Bearer of the Staff with Equal Rank to the Three Dukes, and inspector of Xuzhou; the Prince of Xianyang, Tan, became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 9癸未，上幸同泰寺，講《般若經》，七日而罷，會者數萬人。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the emperor visited Tongtai Temple and lectured on the Prajnaparamita Sutra; after seven days it ended, and those assembled numbered tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the emperor visited Tongtai Temple and lectured on the Prajnaparamita Sutra; after seven days it ended, and those assembled numbered tens of thousands, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 10魏正光以前，阿至羅常附於魏。

translations.literal: Before the Zhengguang era, the Azhi Luo had constantly submitted to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Zhengguang era, the Azhi Luo had constantly submitted to Wei, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 及中原多事，阿至羅亦叛，丞相歡招撫之，阿至羅復降，凡十萬戶。

translations.literal: When the central plains were in turmoil, the Azhi Luo also rebelled. Chancellor Huan won them over, and the Azhi Luo submitted again—one hundred thousand households in all.
translations.idiomatic: When the central plains were in turmoil, the Azhi Luo also rebelled. Chancellor Huan won them over, and the Azhi Luo submitted again—one hundred thousand households in all, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 11三月辛卯，詔復以歡為大行台，使隨宜裁處。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinmao, an edict restored Huan as Grand Commissioner and authorized him to act as he saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinmao, an edict restored Huan as Grand Commissioner and authorized him to act as he saw fit, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歡與之粟帛，議者以為徒費無益，歡不從；

translations.literal: Huan gave them grain and cloth; critics held that it was wasted effort to no purpose, but Huan would not listen;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan gave them grain and cloth; critics held that it was wasted effort to no purpose, but Huan refused to listen;

sentences.zh: 及經略河西，大收其用。

translations.literal: when he later carried out his plans in Hexi, he reaped great use from them.
translations.idiomatic: when he later carried out his plans in Hexi, he reaped great use from them, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 12高乾將之徐州，魏主聞其漏洩機事，乃詔丞相歡曰：「乾邕與朕私有盟約，今乃反覆兩端。

translations.literal: As Gao Gan was about to go to Xuzhou, the Wei sovereign heard that he had leaked state secrets and therefore sent word to Chancellor Huan: "Gan Yong and I privately made a covenant; now he is double-dealing.
translations.idiomatic: As Gao Gan was about to go to Xuzhou, the Wei sovereign heard that he had leaked state secrets and therefore dispatched word to Chancellor Huan: "Gan Yong and I privately made a covenant; now he is double-dealing.

sentences.zh: 」歡聞其與帝盟，亦惡之，即取乾前後數啟論時事者遣使封上。

translations.literal: " Huan, learning of his covenant with the emperor, also came to hate him and at once took Gan's earlier memorials discussing the times, sealed them, and sent them up by envoy.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan, learning of his covenant with the emperor, also came to hate him and immediately took Gan's earlier memorials discussing the times, sealed them, and dispatched them up by envoy.

sentences.zh: 帝召乾，對歡使責之，乾曰：「陛下自立異圖，乃謂臣為反覆，人主加罪，其可辭乎！

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Gan and, in Huan's envoy's presence, reproached him. Gan said, "Your Majesty set up a separate design of your own and therefore call me double-dealing. When a ruler imposes guilt, how can one decline it!
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign summoned Gan and, in Huan's envoy's presence, reproached him. Gan said, "Your Majesty set up a separate design of your own and therefore call me double-dealing. When a ruler imposes guilt, how can one decline it!

sentences.zh: 」遂賜死。

translations.literal: " He was then ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: " He was then ordered to die, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 帝又密敕東徐州刺史潘紹業殺其弟敖曹，敖曹先聞乾死，伏壯士於路，執紹業，得敕書於袍領，遂將十餘騎奔晉陽。

translations.literal: The emperor also secretly ordered Eastern Xuzhou Inspector Pan Shaoye to kill his younger brother Aocao. Aocao, having first heard of Gan's death, set stalwarts in ambush on the road, seized Shaoye, and obtained the secret edict from the lining of his robe; he then took a little more than ten horsemen and fled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign also secretly ordered Eastern Xuzhou Inspector Pan Shaoye to kill his younger brother Aocao. Aocao, having first heard of Gan's death, set stalwarts in ambush on the road, seized Shaoye, and obtained the secret edict from the lining of his robe; he then took a little more than ten horsemen and fled to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 歡抱其首哭曰：「天子枉害司空！

translations.literal: Huan embraced his head and wept, saying, "The Son of Heaven wrongly killed the Minister of Works!
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan embraced his head and wept, saying, "The Son of Heaven wrongly killed the Minister of Works!

sentences.zh: 」敖曹兄仲密為光州刺史，帝敕青州斷其歸路，仲密亦間行奔晉陽。

translations.literal: " Aocao's elder brother Zhongmi was inspector of Guangzhou; the emperor ordered Qingzhou to cut off his return route, and Zhongmi also made his way secretly to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: " Aocao's elder brother Zhongmi was inspector of Guangzhou; the emperor ordered Qingzhou to cut off his return route, and Zhongmi also made his way secretly to Jinyang, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 仲密名慎，以字行。

translations.literal: Zhongmi's personal name was Shen; he was known by his style.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongmi's personal name was Shen; he was known by his style, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 13魏太師魯郡王肅卒。

translations.literal: Wei's Grand Preceptor, Prince Su of Lu commandery, died.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's Grand Preceptor, Prince Su of Lu commandery, died, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 14丙辰，南平元襄王偉卒。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Prince Yuan Xiang of Nanping died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Prince Yuan Xiang of Nanping died, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 15丁巳，魏以趙郡王諶為太尉，南陽王寶炬為太保。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Wei made Prince Chen of Zhao commandery Grand Marshal and Prince Bao Ju of Nanyang Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Wei made Prince Chen of Zhao commandery Grand Marshal and Prince Bao Ju of Nanyang Grand Tutor, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 16魏爾朱兆之入洛也，焚太常樂庫，鐘磬俱盡。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Zhao entered Luoyang, he burned the storehouse of ritual music in the Ministry of Rites, and bells and chimes were all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Zhao entered Luoyang, he burned the storehouse of ritual music in the Ministry of Rites, and bells and chimes were all destroyed, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 節閔帝詔錄尚書事長孫稚、太常卿祖瑩等更造之，至是始成，命曰大成樂。

translations.literal: Emperor Jiemin ordered Chief of the Imperial Secretariat Changsun Zhi, Minister of Rites Zu Ying, and others to make them anew; only now were they completed, and they were named the Music of Great Completion.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jiemin ordered Chief of the Imperial Secretariat Changsun Zhi, Minister of Rites Zu Ying, and others to make them anew; only now were they completed, and they were named the Music of Great Completion, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 17魏青州民耿翔聚眾寇掠三齊，膠州刺史裴粲，專事高談，不為防禦；

translations.literal: The people of Qingzhou in Wei, Geng Xiang, gathered a host and raided the Three Qi; Inspector Pei Can of Jiaozhou devoted himself to lofty talk and made no defense;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, The people of Qingzhou in Wei, Geng Xiang, gathered a host and raided the Three Qi; Inspector Pei Can of Jiaozhou devoted himself to lofty talk and made no defense;

sentences.zh: 夏四月，翔掩襲州城。

translations.literal: in the fourth month of summer, Xiang made a surprise attack on the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: in the fourth month of summer, Xiang made a surprise attack on the prefectural city, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 左右白賊至，粲曰：「豈有此理！

translations.literal: Those at his side reported that bandits had come; Can said, "How could there be such a thing!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Those at his side reported that bandits had come; Can said, "How could there be such a thing!

sentences.zh: 」左右又言已入州門，粲乃徐曰：「耿王來，可引之聽事，自餘部眾，且付城民。

translations.literal: " Those at his side again said they had already entered the prefectural gate; Can then said slowly, "Prince Geng has come—he may be led to the reception hall; as for the rest of the host, let the city folk deal with them.
translations.idiomatic: " Those at his side again said they had already entered the prefectural gate; Can then said slowly, "Prince Geng has come—he may be commanded to the reception hall; as for the rest of the host, let the city folk deal with them.

sentences.zh: 」翔斬之，送首來降。

translations.literal: " Xiang beheaded him and sent his head in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiang beheaded him and dispatched his head in surrender.

sentences.zh: 18五月，魏東徐州民王早等殺刺史崔癢，以下邳來降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the people of Eastern Xuzhou in Wei, Wang Zao and others, killed Inspector Cui Yang and came over from Xiapi to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the people of Eastern Xuzhou in Wei, Wang Zao and others, killed Inspector Cui Yang and came over from Xiapi to surrender, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 19六月壬申，魏以驃騎大將軍樊子鵠為青、膠大使，督濟州刺史蔡俊等討耿翔。

translations.literal: On renshen in the sixth month, Wei made Grand General Who Campaigns on Horseback Fan Zihu commissioner for Qing and Jiao, supervising Inspector Cai Jun of Jizhou and others in attacking Geng Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the sixth month, Wei made Grand General Who Campaigns on Horseback Fan Zihu commissioner for Qing and Jiao, supervising Inspector Cai Jun of Jizhou and others in attacking Geng Xiang, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 20秋七月，魏師至青州，翔棄城來奔，詔以為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Wei troops reached Qingzhou; Xiang abandoned the city and came to submit, and an edict appointed him inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Wei troops reached Qingzhou; Xiang abandoned the city and came to submit, and an edict appointed him inspector of Yanzhou, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 21壬辰，魏以廣陵王欣為大司馬，趙郡王諶為太師。

translations.literal: On renchen, Wei made Prince Xin of Guangling Grand Marshal of War and Prince Chen of Zhao commandery Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wei made Prince Xin of Guangling Grand Marshal of War and Prince Chen of Zhao commandery Grand Preceptor, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以前司徒賀拔允為太尉。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the former Minister of Works Heba Yun was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the former Minister of Works Heba Yun became Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 22初，賀拔岳遣行台郎馮景詣晉陽，丞相歡聞岳使至，甚喜，曰：「賀拔公詎憶吾邪！

translations.literal: Earlier, Heba Yue had sent Mobile Headquarters Gentleman Feng Jing to Jinyang. Chancellor Huan, hearing that Yue's envoy had come, was greatly pleased and said, "Lord Heba—does he remember me after all!
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Heba Yue had dispatched Mobile Headquarters Gentleman Feng Jing to Jinyang. Chancellor Huan, hearing that Yue's envoy had come, was greatly pleased and said, "Lord Heba—does he remember me after all!

sentences.zh: 」與景歃血，約與岳為兄弟。

translations.literal: " He drank blood with Jing and pledged brotherhood with Yue.
translations.idiomatic: " He drank blood with Jing and pledged brotherhood with Yue, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 景還，言於岳曰：「歡奸詐有餘，不可信也。

translations.literal: When Jing returned, he said to Yue, "Huan is treacherous beyond measure and cannot be trusted.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing returned, he told Yue, "Huan is treacherous beyond measure and cannot be trusted.

sentences.zh: 」府司馬宇文泰自請使晉陽以觀歡之為人，歡奇其狀貌，曰：「此兒視瞻非常。

translations.literal: " Staff Officer Yuwen Tai volunteered to go to Jinyang to observe Huan's conduct. Huan marveled at his appearance and said, "This lad's gaze is extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: " Staff Officer Yuwen Tai volunteered to go to Jinyang to observe Huan's conduct. Huan marveled at his appearance and said, "This lad's gaze is extraordinary, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」將留之，泰固求覆命；

translations.literal: " He was about to detain him, but Tai firmly asked to return with his report;
translations.idiomatic: " He was about to detain him, but Tai firmly asked to return with his report;

sentences.zh: 歡既遣而悔之，發驛急追，至關，不及而返。

translations.literal: after Huan had sent him off he regretted it and dispatched post-horses in haste to pursue him; they reached the pass but could not overtake him, and he returned.
translations.idiomatic: after Huan had dispatched him off he regretted it and dispatched post-horses in haste to pursue him; they reached the pass but could not overtake him, and he returned.

sentences.zh: 泰至長安，謂岳曰：「高歡所以未篡者，正憚公兄弟耳；

translations.literal: When Tai reached Chang'an, he said to Yue, "The reason Gao Huan has not yet usurped is that he fears you and your brothers;
translations.idiomatic: When Tai reached Chang'an, he told Yue, "The reason Gao Huan has not yet usurped is that he fears you and your brothers;

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳悅之徒，非所忌也。

translations.literal: men like Hou Mo Chen Yue are not what he fears.
translations.idiomatic: men like Hou Mo Chen Yue are not what he fears, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 公但潛為之備，圖歡不難。

translations.literal: If you secretly prepare against him, plotting against Huan will not be hard.
translations.idiomatic: If you secretly prepare against him, plotting against Huan will not be hard, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 今費也頭控弦之騎不下一萬，夏州刺史斛拔彌俄突勝兵三千餘人，靈州刺史曹泥、河西流民紇豆陵伊利等各擁部眾，未有所屬。

translations.literal: Today the Feiye Tou have no fewer than ten thousand bow-bearing horsemen; Inspector of Xiazhou Hubo Mi'e Tu has more than three thousand picked troops; Inspector of Lingzhou Cao Ni, the Xianbei refugee leader Yidouling Yili, and others each hold their own followings and belong to no one yet.
translations.idiomatic: Today the Feiye Tou have no fewer than ten thousand bow-bearing horsemen; Inspector of Xiazhou Hubo Mi'e Tu has more than three thousand picked troops; Inspector of Lingzhou Cao Ni, the Xianbei refugee leader Yidouling Yili, and others each hold their own followings and belong to no one yet, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 公若移軍近隴，抗其要害，震之以威，懷之以惠，可收其士馬以資吾軍。

translations.literal: If you move your army near Long, confront their vital points, awe them with might, and cherish them with kindness, you can gather their soldiers and horses to supply our army.
translations.idiomatic: If you move your army near Long, confront their vital points, awe them with might, and cherish them with kindness, you can gather their soldiers and horses to supply our army, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 西輯氐、羌，北撫沙塞，還軍長安，匡輔魏室，此桓、文之功也。

translations.literal: In the west unite the Di and Qiang; in the north pacify the desert frontier; then return the army to Chang'an and support the Wei house—this would be the achievement of Duke Huan and Duke Wen of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the west unite the Di and Qiang; in the north pacify the desert frontier; then return the army to Chang'an and support the Wei house—this would be the achievement of Duke Huan and Duke Wen of Qi, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」岳大悅，復遣泰詣洛陽請事，密陳其狀。

translations.literal: " Yue was greatly pleased and again sent Tai to Luoyang to request orders, secretly reporting the situation.
translations.idiomatic: " Yue was greatly pleased and again dispatched Tai to Luoyang to request orders, secretly reporting the situation.

sentences.zh: 魏主喜，加泰武衛將軍，使還報。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign was pleased and promoted Tai to Military Guard General and sent him back with the reply.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor was pleased and promoted Tai to Military Guard General and dispatched him back with the reply.

sentences.zh: 22八月，帝以岳為都督雍、華等二十州諸軍事、雍州刺史，又割心前血，遣使者繼以賜之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the emperor made Yue Commander-in-Chief of the Military Affairs of twenty provinces including Yong and Hua and inspector of Yongzhou, and also cut flesh from before his heart and sent it after him by successive envoys as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the emperor made Yue Commander-in-Chief of the Military Affairs of twenty provinces including Yong and Hua and inspector of Yongzhou, and also cut flesh from before his heart and dispatched it after him by successive envoys as a gift.

sentences.zh: 岳遂引兵西屯平涼，以牧馬為名。

translations.literal: Yue then led his army west and encamped at Pingliang under the pretext of pasturing horses.
translations.idiomatic: Yue then commanded his army west and encamped at Pingliang under the pretext of pasturing horses.

sentences.zh: 斛拔彌俄突、紇豆陵伊利及費也頭-{万俟}-受洛干、鐵勒斛律沙門等皆附於岳，唯曹泥附於歡。

translations.literal: Hubo Mi'e Tu, Yidouling Yili, and the Feiye Tou Wan Nianshou Luogan, the Tiele Hulu Shamen, and others all attached themselves to Yue; only Cao Ni attached himself to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Hubo Mi'e Tu, Yidouling Yili, and the Feiye Tou Wan Nianshou Luogan, the Tiele Hulu Shamen, and others all attached themselves to Yue; only Cao Ni attached himself to Huan, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 秦、南秦、河、渭四州刺史同會平涼，受岳節度。

translations.literal: The inspectors of Qin, Southern Qin, He, and Wei all met at Pingliang and accepted Yue's command.
translations.idiomatic: The inspectors of Qin, Southern Qin, He, and Wei all met at Pingliang and accepted Yue's command, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 岳以夏州被邊重要，欲求良刺史以鎮之，眾舉宇文泰，岳曰：「宇文左丞，吾左右手，何可廢也！

translations.literal: Yue, because Xiazhou lay on the border and was important, wished to find a good inspector to hold it; the assembly nominated Yuwen Tai. Yue said, "Assistant Director Yuwen is my right hand—how can he be dismissed!
translations.idiomatic: Yue, since Xiazhou lay on the border and was important, wished to find a good inspector to hold it; the assembly nominated Yuwen Tai. Yue said, "Assistant Director Yuwen is my right hand—how can he be dismissed!

sentences.zh: 」沉吟累日，卒表用之。

translations.literal: " He pondered for many days and in the end memorialized to appoint him.
translations.idiomatic: " He pondered for many days and in the end memorialized to appoint him, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 21九月癸酉，魏丞相歡表讓王爵，不許；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guiyou, Wei Chancellor Huan memorialized to decline the royal title; it was not granted;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, In the ninth month, on guiyou, Wei Chancellor Huan memorialized to decline the royal title; it was not granted;

sentences.zh: 請分封邑十萬戶頒授勳義，從之。

translations.literal: he asked to distribute one hundred thousand households of his fief among meritorious men, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: he asked to distribute one hundred thousand households of his fief among meritorious men, and this was approved, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 22冬十月庚申，以尚書右僕射何敬容為左僕射，吏部尚書謝舉為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Jingrong was made Left Vice Director, and Minister of Personnel Xie Ju was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Jingrong became Left Vice Director, and Minister of Personnel Xie Ju became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 23十一月癸巳，魏以殷州刺史中山邸珍為徐州大都督、東道行台、僕射，以討下邳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guisi, Wei made Di Zhen of Zhongshan, inspector of Yinzhou, Grand Commander of Xuzhou, Eastern-route Mobile Headquarters, and Vice Director, to attack Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi, Wei made Di Zhen of Zhongshan, inspector of Yinzhou, Grand Commander of Xuzhou, Eastern-route Mobile Headquarters, and Vice Director, to attack Xiapi, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 24十二月丁巳，魏主狩於嵩高；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, the Wei sovereign hunted on Mount Song;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, In the twelfth month, on dingsi, the Wei sovereign hunted on Mount Song;

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸溫湯；

translations.literal: on jisi, he visited the hot springs;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, on jisi, he visited the hot springs;

sentences.zh: 丁丑，還宮。

translations.literal: on dingchou, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: on dingchou, he returned to the palace, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 25魏荊州刺史賀拔勝寇雍州，拔下迮戍，扇動諸蠻；

translations.literal: Heba Sheng, inspector of Jingzhou in Wei, raided Yongzhou, took the fortress of Xiaza, and stirred up the various Man tribes;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Heba Sheng, inspector of Jingzhou in Wei, raided Yongzhou, took the fortress of Xiaza, and stirred up the various Man tribes;

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史廬陵王續遣軍擊之，屢為所敗，漢南震駭。

translations.literal: Inspector Lu Ling Wang Xu of Yongzhou sent troops to attack him and was repeatedly defeated; south of the Han all were shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Lu Ling Wang Xu of Yongzhou dispatched troops to attack him and was repeatedly defeated; south of the Han all were shaken with fear.

sentences.zh: 勝又遣軍攻馮翊、安定、沔陽、酇城，皆拔之。

translations.literal: Sheng again sent troops to attack Fengyi, Anding, Mianyang, and Zuo city and took them all.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng again dispatched troops to attack Fengyi, Anding, Mianyang, and Zuo city and took them all.

sentences.zh: 續遣電威將軍柳仲禮屯谷城以拒之，勝攻之，不克，乃還。

translations.literal: Xu sent Lightning Might General Liu Zhongli to encamp at Gucheng to resist him; Sheng attacked but could not take it and then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Xu dispatched Lightning Might General Liu Zhongli to encamp at Gucheng to resist him; Sheng struck but could not take it and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 於是沔北蕩為丘墟矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon the north of the Mian was laid waste as barren mounds.
translations.idiomatic: then the north of the Mian was laid waste as barren mounds.

sentences.zh: 仲禮，慶遠之孫也。

translations.literal: Zhongli was a grandson of Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongli was a grandson of Qingyuan, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 魏丞相歡患賀拔岳、侯莫陳悅之強，右丞翟嵩曰：「嵩能間之，使其自相屠滅。

translations.literal: Wei Chancellor Huan was troubled by the strength of Heba Yue and Hou Mo Chen Yue. Right Director Zhai Song said, "Song can set them at odds and make them slaughter one another."
translations.idiomatic: Wei Chancellor Huan was troubled by the strength of Heba Yue and Hou Mo Chen Yue. Right Director Zhai Song said, "I can set them at odds and make them slaughter one another."

sentences.zh: 」歡遣之。

translations.literal: Huan sent him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan dispatched him.

sentences.zh: 歡又使長史侯景招撫紇豆陵伊利，伊利不從。

translations.literal: Huan also sent Chief of Staff Hou Jing to win over Yidouling Yili; Yili would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan also dispatched Chief of Staff Hou Jing to win over Yidouling Yili; Yili would not submit.

sentences.zh: 1春正月壬辰，魏丞相歡擊伊利於河西，擒之，遷其部落於河東。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on renchen, Wei Chancellor Huan attacked Yili west of the river, captured him, and moved his tribe east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on renchen, Wei Chancellor Huan struck Yili west of the river, took him, and moved his tribe east of the river.

sentences.zh: 魏主讓之曰：「伊利不侵不叛，為國純臣。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign reproached him, saying, "Yili did not invade and did not rebel; he was a pure minister of the state.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor reproached him, saying, "Yili did not invade and did not rebel; he was a pure minister of the state.

sentences.zh: 王忽伐之，詎有一介行人先請之乎！

translations.literal: The king suddenly attacked him—was there even a single envoy sent ahead to ask permission!"
translations.idiomatic: The king suddenly struck him—was there even a single envoy dispatched ahead to ask permission!"

sentences.zh: 2魏東梁州民夷作亂，二月，詔以行東雍州事豐陽泉企討平之。

translations.literal: The people of Eastern Liangzhou in Wei, Yi and barbarians, rose in disorder. In the second month, an edict ordered Quan Qi of Fengyang, acting for Eastern Yongzhou, to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Eastern Liangzhou in Wei, Yi and barbarians, rose in disorder. In the second month, an edict ordered Quan Qi of Fengyang, acting for Eastern Yongzhou, to pacify them, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 企世為商、洛豪族，魏世祖以其曾祖景言為本縣令，封丹水侯，使其子孫襲之。

translations.literal: The Quan clan for generations had been a powerful house of Shang and Luo. Emperor Shizu of Wei had made his great-grandfather Jingyan magistrate of the native district and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Danshui, with the office to pass to his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: The Quan clan for generations had been a powerful house of Shang and Luo. Emperor Shizu of Wei had made his great-grandfather Jingyan magistrate of the native district and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Danshui, with the office to pass to his descendants, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 3壬戌，魏大赦。

translations.literal: On renxu, Wei proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wei proclaimed a general amnesty, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 4癸亥，上耕藉田。

translations.literal: On guihai, the emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the emperor plowed the sacred field, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 5魏永寧浮圖災，觀者皆哭，聲振城闕。

translations.literal: The Yongning pagoda in Wei caught fire; the onlookers all wept, and the sound shook the city towers.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongning pagoda in Wei caught fire; the onlookers all wept, and the sound shook the city towers, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 6魏賀拔岳將討曹泥，使都督武川趙貴至夏州與宇文泰謀之，泰曰：「曹泥孤城阻遠，未足為憂。

translations.literal: Heba Yue of Wei was about to campaign against Cao Ni and sent Supervisor Zhao Gui of Wuchuan to Xiazhou to consult with Yuwen Tai. Tai said, "Cao Ni holds a lone city far off in difficult country and is not worth worry.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Yue of Wei was about to campaign against Cao Ni and dispatched Supervisor Zhao Gui of Wuchuan to Xiazhou to consult with Yuwen Tai. Tai said, "Cao Ni holds a lone city far off in difficult country and is not worth worry.

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳悅貪而無信，宜先圖之。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue is greedy and faithless; he should be dealt with first."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Hou Mo Chen Yue is greedy and faithless; he should be dealt with first."

sentences.zh: 」岳不聽，召悅會於高平，與共討泥。

translations.literal: Heba Yue would not listen. He summoned Hou Mo Chen Yue to meet at Gaoping and together attack Ni.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Yue refused to listen. He summoned Hou Mo Chen Yue to meet at Gaoping and together attack Ni.

sentences.zh: 悅既得翟嵩之言，乃謀取岳。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue, having received Zhai Song's message, then plotted to seize Heba Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Mo Chen Yue, having received Zhai Song's message, then plotted to seize Heba Yue, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 岳數與悅宴語，長史武川雷紹諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Heba Yue repeatedly feasted and talked with Hou Mo Chen Yue. Chief Clerk Lei Shao of Wuchuan remonstrated, but he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Yue repeatedly feasted and talked with Hou Mo Chen Yue. Chief Clerk Lei Shao of Wuchuan remonstrated, but he refused to listen.

sentences.zh: 岳使悅前行，至河曲，悅誘岳入營坐，論軍事。

translations.literal: Heba Yue sent Hou Mo Chen Yue ahead. When they reached Hequ, Hou Mo Chen Yue lured Heba Yue into the camp to sit and discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Yue dispatched Hou Mo Chen Yue ahead. When they reached Hequ, Hou Mo Chen Yue lured Heba Yue into the camp to sit and discuss military affairs.

sentences.zh: 悅陽稱腹痛而起，其婿元洪景拔刀斬岳。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue pretended stomach pain and rose; his son-in-law Yuan Hongjing drew a blade and beheaded Heba Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Mo Chen Yue pretended stomach pain and rose; his son-in-law Yuan Hongjing drew a blade and beheaded Heba Yue, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 岳左右皆散走，悅遣人諭之云：「我別受旨，止取一人，諸君勿怖。

translations.literal: Those at Heba Yue's side all scattered and fled. Hou Mo Chen Yue sent men to reassure them, saying, "I received a separate order to take only one man; you need not fear."
translations.idiomatic: Those at Heba Yue's side all scattered and fled. Hou Mo Chen Yue dispatched men to reassure them, saying, "I received a separate order to take only one man; you need not fear."

sentences.zh: 」眾以為然，皆不敢動。

translations.literal: The host thought it so and none dared move.
translations.idiomatic: The host thought it so and none dared move, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 而悅心猶豫，不即撫納，乃還入隴，屯水洛城。

translations.literal: Yet Hou Mo Chen Yue still hesitated and did not at once win them over; he returned into Long and encamped at Shuilo city.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Hou Mo Chen Yue still hesitated and did not immediately win them over; he returned into Long and encamped at Shuilo city.

sentences.zh: 岳眾散還平涼，趙貴詣悅請岳屍葬之，悅許之。

translations.literal: Heba Yue's forces scattered back to Pingliang. Zhao Gui went to Hou Mo Chen Yue to ask for Heba Yue's corpse for burial; Hou Mo Chen Yue agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Yue's forces scattered back to Pingliang. Zhao Gui went to Hou Mo Chen Yue to ask for Heba Yue's corpse for burial; Hou Mo Chen Yue agreed, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 岳既死，悅軍中皆相賀，行台朗中薛□私謂所親曰：「悅才略素寡，輒害良將，吾屬今為人虜矣，何賀之有！

translations.literal: After Heba Yue died, all in Hou Mo Chen Yue's army congratulated one another. Mobile Headquarters Gentleman Xue Que said privately to those close to him, "Hou Mo Chen Yue has always been short on talent and strategy, yet rashly killed a fine general—we are captives now; what is there to congratulate!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, After Heba Yue died, all in Hou Mo Chen Yue's army congratulated one another. Mobile Headquarters Gentleman Xue Que said privately to those close to him, "Hou Mo Chen Yue has always been short on talent and strategy, yet rashly killed a fine general—we are captives now; what is there to congratulate!"

sentences.zh: 」□，真度之從孫也。

translations.literal: " Que was a grandnephew of Zhendu.
translations.idiomatic: " Que was a grandnephew of Zhendu, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 7岳眾未有所屬，諸將以都督武川寇洛年最長，推使總諸軍；

translations.literal: Heba Yue's host had no leader. The generals, because Supervisor Kou Luo of Wuchuan was eldest in years, pushed him to command all the armies;
translations.idiomatic: Heba Yue's host had no leader. The generals, since Supervisor Kou Luo of Wuchuan was eldest in years, pushed him to command all the armies;

sentences.zh: 洛素無威略，不能齊眾，乃自請避位。

translations.literal: Luo had never had authority or plan and could not unite the host, so he himself asked to step aside.
translations.idiomatic: Luo had never had authority or plan and could not unite the host, so he himself asked to step aside, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 趙貴曰：「宇文夏州英略冠世，遠近歸心，賞罰嚴明，士卒用命。

translations.literal: Zhao Gui said, "Yuwen of Xia province has talent that crowns the age; near and far turn to him. Rewards and punishments are strict and clear; soldiers obey his orders.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gui said, "Yuwen of Xia province has talent that crowns the age; near and far turn to him. Rewards and punishments are strict and clear; soldiers obey his orders, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 若迎而奉之，大事濟矣。

translations.literal: If we welcome and support him, the great affair will succeed."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If we welcome and support him, the great affair will succeed."

sentences.zh: 」諸將或欲南召賀拔勝，或欲東告魏朝，猶豫未決。

translations.literal: Some generals wished to summon Heba Sheng from the south, or report east to the Wei court, and hesitated without decision.
translations.idiomatic: Some generals wished to summon Heba Sheng from the south, or report east to the Wei court, and hesitated without decision, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 都督盛樂杜朔周曰：「遠水不救近火，今日之事，非宇文夏州無能濟者，趙將軍議是也。

translations.literal: Supervisor Du Shuozhou of Shengle said, "Distant water will not save a nearby fire. Today's affair cannot be settled except by Yuwen of Xia province; General Zhao's plan is right.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor Du Shuozhou of Shengle said, "Distant water will not save a nearby fire. Today's affair cannot be settled except by Yuwen of Xia province; General Zhao's plan is right, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 朔周請輕騎告哀，且迎之。

translations.literal: Shuozhou asks to go with light horse to announce mourning and also to welcome him."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Shuozhou asks to go with light horse to announce mourning and also to welcome him."

sentences.zh: 」眾乃使朔周馳至夏州召泰。

translations.literal: The assembly then sent Shuozhou galloping to Xiazhou to summon Tai.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly then dispatched Shuozhou galloping to Xiazhou to summon Tai.

sentences.zh: 8泰與將佐賓客共議去留，前太中大夫穎川韓褒曰：「此天授也，又何疑乎！

translations.literal: Tai discussed going or staying with his staff, retainers, and guests. Former Grand Master of Palace Han Bao of Yingchuan said, "This is Heaven's grant—why doubt it!
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai discussed going or staying with his staff, retainers, and guests. Former Grand Master of Palace Han Bao of Yingchuan said, "This is Heaven's grant—why doubt it!

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳悅，井中蛙耳，使君往，必擒之。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue is a frog in a well; if my lord goes, you will surely capture him."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Hou Mo Chen Yue is a frog in a well; if my lord goes, you will surely capture him."

sentences.zh: 」眾以為：「悅在水洛，去平涼不遠，若已有賀拔公之眾，則圖之實難，願且留以觀變。

translations.literal: The assembly thought, "Hou Mo Chen Yue is at Shuilo, not far from Pingliang. If he already has Lord Heba's troops, taking him will truly be hard. We wish to stay and watch how things change."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, The assembly thought, "Hou Mo Chen Yue is at Shuilo, not far from Pingliang. If he already has Lord Heba's troops, taking him will truly be hard. We wish to stay and watch how things change."

sentences.zh: 」泰曰：「悅既害元帥，自應乘勢直據平涼，而退屯水洛，吾知其無能為也。

translations.literal: Tai said, "Hou Mo Chen Yue has already killed the commander-in-chief; he ought to press the advantage straight to Pingliang. Instead he withdraws to camp at Shuilo—I know he can do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai said, "Hou Mo Chen Yue has already killed the commander-in-chief; he ought to press the advantage straight to Pingliang. Instead he withdraws to camp at Shuilo—I know he can do nothing.

sentences.zh: 夫難得易失者，時也。

translations.literal: What is hard to gain and easy to lose is opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: What is hard to gain and easy to lose is opportunity, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 若不早赴，眾心將離。

translations.literal: If we do not go soon, the host's heart will scatter.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not go soon, the host's heart will scatter, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 9夏州首望都督彌姐元進陰謀應悅，泰知之，與帳下都督高平蔡祐謀執之，祐曰：「元進會當反噬，不如殺之。

translations.literal: Chief Chieftain Supervisor Mijie Yuanjin of Xia province plotted in secret to respond to Hou Mo Chen Yue. Tai knew it and with Tent Supervisor Cai You of Gaoping plotted to seize him. You said, "Yuanjin will turn and bite—better kill him."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Chief Chieftain Supervisor Mijie Yuanjin of Xia province plotted in secret to respond to Hou Mo Chen Yue. Tai knew it and with Tent Supervisor Cai You of Gaoping plotted to seize him. You said, "Yuanjin will turn and bite—better kill him."

sentences.zh: 」泰曰：「汝有大決。

translations.literal: " Tai said, "You have great resolve."
translations.idiomatic: " Yuwen Tai said, "You have great resolve."

sentences.zh: 」乃召元進等入計事，泰曰：「隴賊逆亂，當與諸人戮力討之，諸人似有不同者，何也？

translations.literal: He then summoned Yuanjin and the others to discuss affairs. Tai said, "The Long rebels are in disorder; we ought to join strength with all of you to punish them. You seem to differ—why?"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, He then summoned Yuanjin and the others to discuss affairs. Tai said, "The Long rebels are in disorder; we ought to join strength with all of you to punish them. You seem to differ—why?"

sentences.zh: 」祐即被甲持刀直入，瞋目謂諸將曰：「朝謀夕異，何以為人！

translations.literal: You at once donned armor, took blade in hand, and entered directly. Glaring at the generals he said, "Plans change morning and evening—how can one be a man!
translations.idiomatic: You immediately donned armor, took blade in hand, and entered directly. Glaring at the generals he said, "Plans change morning and evening—how can one be a man!

sentences.zh: 今日必斷奸人首！

translations.literal: Today we must cut off traitors' heads!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Today we must cut off traitors' heads!"

sentences.zh: 」舉坐皆叩頭曰：「願有所擇。

translations.literal: All present kowtowed and said, "We wish to choose."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, All present kowtowed and said, "We wish to choose."

sentences.zh: 」祐乃叱元進，斬之，並誅其黨，因與諸將同盟討悅。

translations.literal: You then shouted at Yuanjin and beheaded him, and executed his faction as well; he then swore alliance with the generals to attack Hou Mo Chen Yue.
translations.idiomatic: You then shouted at Yuanjin and beheaded him, and executed his faction as well; he then swore alliance with the generals to attack Hou Mo Chen Yue, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 泰謂祐曰：「吾今以爾為子，爾其以我為父乎？

translations.literal: Tai said to You, "I now take you as son—will you take me as father?"
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai told You, "I now take you as son—will you take me as father?"

sentences.zh: 10泰與帳下輕騎馳赴平涼，令杜朔周帥眾先據彈箏峽。

translations.literal: Tai with light horse of his tent galloped to Pingliang and ordered Du Shuozhou to lead the host first to hold Tanzheng Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai with light horse of his tent galloped to Pingliang and ordered Du Shuozhou to lead the army first to hold Tanzheng Gorge.

sentences.zh: 時民間惶懼，逃散者多，軍士爭欲掠之，朔周曰：「宇文公方伐罪弔民，奈何助賊為虐乎！

translations.literal: At that time the people were in fear and many fled and scattered. Soldiers vied to plunder them. Shuozhou said, "Lord Yuwen is now punishing crime and comforting the people—how can you aid the bandits in their cruelty!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, At that time the people were in fear and many fled and scattered. Soldiers vied to plunder them. Shuozhou said, "Lord Yuwen is now punishing crime and comforting the people—how can you aid the bandits in their cruelty!"

sentences.zh: 」撫而遣之，遠近悅附；

translations.literal: He comforted them and sent them away; near and far were pleased and attached themselves.
translations.idiomatic: He comforted them and dispatched them away; near and far were pleased and attached themselves.

sentences.zh: 泰聞而嘉之。

translations.literal: Tai heard and praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai heard and praised him.

sentences.zh: 朔周本姓赫連，曾祖庫多汗避難改焉。

translations.literal: Shuozhou's original surname had been Helian; his great-grandfather Kuhuohan had changed it to escape trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Shuozhou's original surname had been Helian; his great-grandfather Kuhuohan had changed it to escape trouble, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 泰命復其舊姓，名之曰達。

translations.literal: Tai ordered the old surname restored and gave him the name Da.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai ordered the old surname restored and gave him the name Da.

sentences.zh: 11丞相歡使侯景招撫岳眾，泰至安定，遇之，謂曰：「賀拔公雖死，宇文泰尚存，卿何為者！

translations.literal: Chancellor Huan sent Hou Jing to win over Heba Yue's host. When Tai reached Anding he met him and said, "Though Lord Heba is dead, Yuwen Tai still lives—what are you about!"
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan dispatched Hou Jing to win over Heba Yue's host. When Tai reached Anding he met him and said, "Though Lord Heba is dead, Yuwen Tai still lives—what are you about!"

sentences.zh: 」景失色曰：「我猶箭耳，唯人所射。

translations.literal: Jing turned pale and said, "I am but an arrow—only at others' shooting."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Jing turned pale and said, "I am but an arrow—only at others' shooting."

sentences.zh: 」遂還。

translations.literal: He then returned.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, He then returned.

sentences.zh: 泰至平涼，哭岳甚慟，將士皆悲喜。

translations.literal: When Tai reached Pingliang he wept for Heba Yue with extreme grief; officers and soldiers were both sorrowful and joyful.
translations.idiomatic: When Tai reached Pingliang he wept for Heba Yue with extreme grief; officers and soldiers were both sorrowful and joyful, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 12歡復使侯景與散騎常侍代郡張華原、義寧太守太安王基勞泰，泰不受，欲劫留之，曰：「留則共享富貴，不然，命在今日。

translations.literal: Huan again sent Hou Jing with Palace Attendant Zhang Huayuan of Dai commandery and Administrator Wang Ji of Tai'an in Yining to console Tai. Tai would not accept and wished to detain them by force, saying, "Stay and we share wealth and honor; otherwise your lives end today."
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan again dispatched Hou Jing with Palace Attendant Zhang Huayuan of Dai commandery and Administrator Wang Ji of Tai'an in Yining to console Tai. Tai would not accept and wished to detain them by force, saying, "Stay and we share wealth and honor; otherwise your lives end today."

sentences.zh: 」華原曰：「明公欲脅使者以死亡，此非華原所懼也。

translations.literal: Huayuan said, "My lord wishes to coerce envoys with death—this is not what Huayuan fears."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Huayuan said, "My lord wishes to coerce envoys with death—this is not what Huayuan fears."

sentences.zh: 」泰乃遣之。

translations.literal: Tai then sent them off.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai then dispatched them off.

sentences.zh: 基還，言「泰雄傑，請及其未定擊滅之。

translations.literal: When Ji returned he said, "Tai is a hero; strike and destroy him before he is settled."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, When Ji returned he said, "Tai is a hero; strike and destroy him before he is settled."

sentences.zh: 」歡曰：「卿不見賀拔、侯莫陳乎！

translations.literal: Huan said, "Have you not seen Heba and Hou Mo Chen!
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan said, "Have you not seen Heba and Hou Mo Chen!

sentences.zh: 吾當以計拱手取之。

translations.literal: I shall take them with a plan, hands empty.
translations.idiomatic: I shall take them with a plan, hands empty, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 13魏主聞岳死，遣武衛將軍元毘慰勞岳軍，召還洛陽，並召侯莫陳悅。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign heard of Heba Yue's death and sent Military Guard General Yuan Pi to console Heba Yue's army, summoning them back to Luoyang, and also summoned Hou Mo Chen Yue.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor heard of Heba Yue's death and dispatched Military Guard General Yuan Pi to console Heba Yue's army, summoning them back to Luoyang, and also summoned Hou Mo Chen Yue.

sentences.zh: 毘至平涼，軍中已奉宇文泰為主；

translations.literal: When Pi reached Pingliang, the army had already made Yuwen Tai their leader;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, When Pi reached Pingliang, the army had already made Yuwen Tai their leader;

sentences.zh: 悅既附丞相歡，不肯應召。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue, having attached himself to Chancellor Huan, would not answer the summons.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Mo Chen Yue, having attached himself to Chancellor Huan, would not answer the summons, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 泰因元毘上表稱：「臣岳忽罹非命，都督寇洛等令臣權掌軍事。

translations.literal: Tai thereupon had Yuan Pi memorialize, saying, "Your servant Heba Yue suddenly met violent death; Supervisor Kou Luo and others ordered your servant to hold military affairs provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai then had Yuan Pi memorialize, saying, "Your servant Heba Yue suddenly met violent death; Supervisor Kou Luo and others ordered your servant to hold military affairs provisionally.

sentences.zh: 奉詔召岳軍入京，今高歡之眾已至河東，侯莫陳悅猶在水洛，士卒多是西人，顧戀鄉邑，若逼令赴闕，悅躡其後，歡邀其前，恐敗國殄民，所損更甚。

translations.literal: We received an edict summoning Heba Yue's army to the capital. Now Gao Huan's host has reached Hedong and Hou Mo Chen Yue is still at Shuilo. Most soldiers are westerners who long for their native districts. If forced to the court, Hou Mo Chen Yue will tread on their rear and Huan will bar their front—we fear the state will be ruined and the people destroyed, and the loss will be still greater.
translations.idiomatic: We received an edict summoning Heba Yue's army to the capital. Now Gao Huan's host has reached Hedong and Hou Mo Chen Yue is still at Shuilo. Most soldiers are westerners who long for their native districts. If forced to the court, Hou Mo Chen Yue will tread on their rear and Huan will bar their front—we fear the state will be ruined and the people destroyed, and the loss will be still greater, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 乞少賜停緩，徐事誘導，漸就東引。

translations.literal: We beg a little delay and gentle guidance, gradually drawing them east."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, We beg a little delay and gentle guidance, gradually drawing them east."

sentences.zh: 」魏主乃以泰為大都督，即統岳軍。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign then made Tai Grand Commander and he at once took command of Heba Yue's army.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor then made Tai Grand Commander and he immediately took command of Heba Yue's army.

sentences.zh: 14初，岳以東雍州刺史李虎為左廂大都督，岳死，虎奔荊州，說賀拔勝使收岳眾，勝不從。

translations.literal: Earlier, Heba Yue had made Li Hu, inspector of Eastern Yongzhou, Grand Commander of the Left Wing. When Heba Yue died, Hu fled to Jingzhou and urged Heba Sheng to gather Heba Yue's host; Sheng would not.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Heba Yue had made Li Hu, inspector of Eastern Yongzhou, Grand Commander of the Left Wing. When Heba Yue died, Hu fled to Jingzhou and urged Heba Sheng to gather Heba Yue's host; Sheng would not.

sentences.zh: 虎聞宇文泰代岳統眾，乃自荊州還赴之。

translations.literal: Hu heard that Yuwen Tai had replaced Heba Yue in commanding the host and came back from Jingzhou to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Hu heard that Yuwen Tai had replaced Heba Yue in commanding the army and came back from Jingzhou to join him.

sentences.zh: 至閿鄉，為丞相歡別將所獲，送洛陽。

translations.literal: At Wenxiang he was seized by a detached commander of Chancellor Huan and sent to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At Wenxiang he was seized by a detached commander of Chancellor Huan and dispatched to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 魏主方謀取關中，得虎甚喜，拜衛將軍，厚賜之，使就泰。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign was then plotting to take Guanzhong; obtaining Hu he was greatly pleased, made him Military Guard General, gave him rich gifts, and sent him on to Tai.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor was then plotting to take Guanzhong; obtaining Hu he was greatly pleased, made him Military Guard General, gave him rich gifts, and dispatched him on to Tai.

sentences.zh: 虎，歆之玄孫也。

translations.literal: Hu was a great-grandson of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: Hu was a great-grandson of Xin, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 15泰與悅書，責以「賀拔公有大功於朝廷。

translations.literal: Tai wrote Hou Mo Chen Yue reproaching him: "Lord Heba had great merit toward the court.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai wrote Hou Mo Chen Yue reproaching him: "Lord Heba had great merit toward the court.

sentences.zh: 君名微行薄，賀拔公薦君為隴右行台。

translations.literal: Your name is slight and your conduct thin; Lord Heba recommended you as mobile headquarters of Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Your name is slight and your conduct thin; Lord Heba recommended you as mobile headquarters of Longyou, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 又高氏專權，君與賀拔公同受密旨，屢結盟約；

translations.literal: Moreover the Gao clan monopolizes power; you and Lord Heba together received secret orders and repeatedly swore alliance;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Moreover the Gao clan monopolizes power; you and Lord Heba together received secret orders and repeatedly swore alliance;

sentences.zh: 而君黨附國賊，共危宗廟，口血未乾，匕首已發。

translations.literal: yet you sided with the state's enemy and together endangered the altars of soil and grain—the blood of the oath was not dry before the dagger struck.
translations.idiomatic: yet you sided with the state's enemy and together endangered the altars of soil and grain—the blood of the oath was not dry before the dagger struck, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 今吾與君皆受詔還闕，今日進退，唯君是視：君若下隴東邁，吾亦自北道同歸；

translations.literal: Now you and I both received orders to return to the court. Today whether we advance or retreat depends on you alone: if you descend Long and march east, I too will return by the northern road;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Now you and I both received orders to return to the court. Today whether we advance or retreat depends on you alone: if you descend Long and march east, I too will return by the northern road;

sentences.zh: 若首鼠兩端，吾則指日相見！

translations.literal: if you waver between two sides, I shall meet you within days!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, if you waver between two sides, I shall meet you within days!"

sentences.zh: 16魏主問泰以安秦、隴之策，泰表言：「宜召悅授以內官，或處以瓜、涼一籓；

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign asked Tai for a plan to settle Qin and Long. Tai memorialized, "Hou Mo Chen Yue should be summoned and given an inner post, or placed in a fief of Guazhou or Liangzhou; otherwise he will be a trouble in the end."
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor asked Tai for a plan to settle Qin and Long. Tai memorialized, "Hou Mo Chen Yue should be summoned and given an inner post, or placed in a fief of Guazhou or Liangzhou; otherwise he will be a trouble in the end."

sentences.zh: 不然，終為後患。

translations.literal: Inspector Shi Gui of Yuanzhou had long been trusted by Heba Yue. At the Hequ crisis he instead held the city for Hou Mo Chen Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Shi Gui of Yuanzhou had long been trusted by Heba Yue. At the Hequ crisis he instead held the city for Hou Mo Chen Yue, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 17原州刺史史歸，素為賀拔岳所親任，河曲之變，反為悅守。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue sent his partisans Wang Bohe and Cheng Ci'an with two thousand men to help Gui hold Yuanzhou. Tai sent Supervisor Hou Mo Chen Chong with a thousand light horse to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Mo Chen Yue dispatched his partisans Wang Bohe and Cheng Ci'an with two thousand men to help Gui hold Yuanzhou. Tai dispatched Supervisor Hou Mo Chen Chong with a thousand light horse to strike them.

sentences.zh: 悅遣其黨王伯和、成次安將兵二千助歸鎮原州，泰遣都督侯莫陳崇帥輕騎一千襲之。

translations.literal: Chong by night led ten horse straight to the foot of the wall; the rest of the host lay in ambush on nearby roads.
translations.idiomatic: Chong by night commanded ten horse straight to the foot of the wall; the rest of the army lay in ambush on nearby roads.

sentences.zh: 崇乘夜將十騎直抵城下，餘眾皆伏於近路；

translations.literal: Gui, seeing few horsemen, made no preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Gui, seeing few horsemen, made no preparations, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歸見騎少，不設備。

translations.literal: Chong at once entered and seized the gate. Magistrate Li Xian of Longxi and his younger brother Yuanmu were in the city and acted as Chong's agents within.
translations.idiomatic: Chong immediately entered and seized the gate. Magistrate Li Xian of Longxi and his younger brother Yuanmu were in the city and acted as Chong's agents within.

sentences.zh: 崇即入，據城門，高平令隴西李賢及弟遠穆在城中，為崇內應。

translations.literal: Thereupon inside and outside raised a clamor; the ambush all rose, and they captured Gui and Ci'an, Bohe, and the rest and returned to Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: then inside and outside raised a clamor; the ambush all rose, and they took Gui and Ci'an, Bohe, and the rest and returned to Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 於是中外鼓噪，伏兵悉起，遂擒歸及次安、伯和等歸於平涼。

translations.literal: Tai memorialized that Chong should act as inspector of Yuanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai memorialized that Chong should act as inspector of Yuanzhou;

sentences.zh: 泰表崇行原州事；

translations.literal: in the third month Tai led troops to attack Hou Mo Chen Yue. Reaching Yuanzhou, all armies assembled.
translations.idiomatic: in the third month Tai commanded troops to attack Hou Mo Chen Yue. Reaching Yuanzhou, all armies assembled.

sentences.zh: 三月，泰引兵擊悅，至原州，眾軍畢集。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day guichou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day guichou, there was a solar eclipse, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 18夏四月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Li Bi, inspector of Southern Qinzhou in Longxi, urged Hou Mo Chen Yue, saying, "Lord Heba was guiltless yet you harmed him, and you do not comfort and win his host. Now they follow Yuwen of Xia province, proclaiming revenge for their lord—this momentum cannot be resisted. You should lay down arms and apologize!
translations.idiomatic: Li Bi, inspector of Southern Qinzhou in Longxi, urged Hou Mo Chen Yue, saying, "Lord Heba was guiltless yet you harmed him, and you do not comfort and win his host. They now follow Yuwen of Xia province, proclaiming revenge for their lord—this momentum cannot be resisted. You should lay down arms and apologize!

sentences.zh: 19魏南秦州刺史隴西李弼說侯莫陳悅曰：「賀拔公無罪而公害之，又不撫納其眾，今奉宇文夏州以來，聲言為主報仇，此其勢不可敵也，宜解兵謝之！

translations.literal: Otherwise you will surely meet disaster."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Otherwise you will surely meet disaster."

sentences.zh: 不然，必及禍。

translations.literal: Otherwise you will surely meet disaster."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Otherwise you will surely meet disaster."

sentences.zh: 」悅不從。

translations.literal: " Hou Mo Chen Yue would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " Hou Mo Chen Yue refused to listen.

sentences.zh: 20宇文泰引兵上隴，留兄子導為都督，鎮原州。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai led troops up Long, leaving his nephew Dao as supervisor to hold Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai commanded troops up Long, leaving his nephew Dao as supervisor to hold Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 泰軍令嚴肅，秋毫無犯，百姓大悅。

translations.literal: Tai's army discipline was severe; not a hair was harmed, and the people were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Tai's army discipline was severe; not a hair was harmed, and the people were greatly pleased, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 軍出木狹關，雪深二尺，泰倍道兼行，出其不意。

translations.literal: The army issued through Muxia Pass; snow was two feet deep. Tai marched day and night by double stages and took them unawares.
translations.idiomatic: The army issued through Muxia Pass; snow was two feet deep. Tai marched day and night by double stages and took them unawares, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 悅聞之，退保略陽，留萬人守水洛。

translations.literal: When Hou Mo Chen Yue heard, he withdrew to hold Luoyang and left ten thousand men to guard Shuilo.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Mo Chen Yue heard, he withdrew to hold Luoyang and left ten thousand men to guard Shuilo, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 泰至，水洛即降。

translations.literal: When Tai arrived, Shuilo surrendered at once.
translations.idiomatic: When Tai arrived, Shuilo submitted at once.

sentences.zh: 泰遣輕騎數百趣略陽，悅退保上邽，召李弼與之拒泰。

translations.literal: Tai sent several hundred light horse to hurry toward Luoyang. Hou Mo Chen Yue withdrew to hold Shanggui and summoned Li Bi to resist Tai with him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai dispatched several hundred light horse to hurry toward Luoyang. Hou Mo Chen Yue withdrew to hold Shanggui and summoned Li Bi to resist Tai with him.

sentences.zh: 弼知悅必敗，陰遣使詣泰，請為內應。

translations.literal: Bi knew Hou Mo Chen Yue would surely be defeated and secretly sent envoys to Tai asking to be an agent within.
translations.idiomatic: Bi knew Hou Mo Chen Yue would surely be defeated and secretly dispatched envoys to Tai asking to be an agent within.

sentences.zh: 悅棄州城，南保山險，弼謂所部曰：「侯莫陳公欲還秦州，汝輩何不裝束！

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue abandoned the prefectural city and withdrew south to rugged hills. Bi said to his troops, "Lord Hou Mo Chen wishes to return to Qinzhou—why do you not pack up!"
translations.idiomatic: Hou Mo Chen Yue abandoned the prefectural city and withdrew south to rugged hills. Bi told his troops, "Lord Hou Mo Chen wishes to return to Qinzhou—why do you not pack up!"

sentences.zh: 」弼妻，悅之姨也，眾咸信之，爭趣上邽。

translations.literal: " Bi's wife was Hou Mo Chen Yue's aunt; all trusted him and vied to hurry to Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: " Bi's wife was Hou Mo Chen Yue's aunt; all trusted him and vied to hurry to Shanggui, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 弼先據城門以安集之，遂舉城降泰，泰即以弼為秦州刺史。

translations.literal: Bi first seized the city gates to calm and gather them, then surrendered the whole city to Tai; Tai at once made Bi inspector of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bi first seized the city gates to calm and gather them, then submitted the whole city to Tai; Tai immediately made Bi inspector of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 其夜，悅出軍將戰，軍自驚潰。

translations.literal: That night Hou Mo Chen Yue led troops out to give battle; the army panicked and collapsed of itself.
translations.idiomatic: That night Hou Mo Chen Yue commanded troops out to give battle; the army panicked and collapsed of itself.

sentences.zh: 悅性猜忌，既敗，不聽左右近己，與其二弟並子及謀殺岳者七八人棄軍迸走。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue was suspicious by nature. After defeat he would not listen to those close to him; with his two younger brothers, his sons, and seven or eight who had plotted Heba Yue's murder he abandoned the army and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Mo Chen Yue was suspicious by nature. After defeat he refused to listen to those close to him; with his two younger brothers, his sons, and seven or eight who had plotted Heba Yue's murder he abandoned the army and fled.

sentences.zh: 數日之中，槃桓往來，不知所趣。

translations.literal: For several days he wandered back and forth, not knowing where to go.
translations.idiomatic: For several days he wandered back and forth, not knowing where to go, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 左右勸向靈州依曹泥，悅從之。

translations.literal: Those at his side urged him to go to Lingzhou and rely on Cao Ni; Hou Mo Chen Yue agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Those at his side urged him to go to Lingzhou and rely on Cao Ni; Hou Mo Chen Yue agreed, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 自乘騾，令左右皆步從，欲自山中趣靈州。

translations.literal: He himself rode a mule and ordered all attendants to follow on foot, intending to reach Lingzhou through the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: He himself rode a mule and ordered all attendants to follow on foot, intending to reach Lingzhou through the mountains, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 宇文泰使原州都督賀拔穎追之，悅望見追騎，縊死於野。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai sent Heba Ying, supervisor of Yuanzhou, in pursuit. When Hou Mo Chen Yue saw the pursuing horse, he hanged himself in the wild.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai dispatched Heba Ying, supervisor of Yuanzhou, in pursuit. When Hou Mo Chen Yue saw the pursuing horse, he hanged himself in the wild.

sentences.zh: 21泰入上邽，引薛□為記室參軍。

translations.literal: Tai entered Shanggui and took Xue Que as recorder in the headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai entered Shanggui and took Xue Que as recorder in the headquarters.

sentences.zh: 收悅府庫，財物山積，泰秋毫不取，皆以賞士卒；

translations.literal: He seized Hou Mo Chen Yue's treasury; goods piled like mountains. Tai took not a whit in autumn and gave all to reward the soldiers;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, He seized Hou Mo Chen Yue's treasury; goods piled like mountains. Tai took not a whit in autumn and gave all to reward the soldiers;

sentences.zh: 左右竊一銀甕以歸，泰知而罪之，即剖賜將士。

translations.literal: an attendant stole a silver jar and took it home. When Tai learned of it he punished him and at once cut it up to give the generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: an attendant stole a silver jar and took it home. When Tai learned of it he punished him and immediately cut it up to give the generals and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 22悅黨豳州刺史孫定兒據州不下，有眾數萬，泰遣都督中山劉亮襲之。

translations.literal: Hou Mo Chen Yue's partisan Sun Ding'er, inspector of Binzhou, held the province and would not submit, with a host of tens of thousands. Tai sent Liu Liang of Zhongshan to strike him.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Mo Chen Yue's partisan Sun Ding'er, inspector of Binzhou, held the province and would not submit, with a host of tens of thousands. Tai dispatched Liu Liang of Zhongshan to strike him.

sentences.zh: 定兒以大軍遠，不為備；

translations.literal: Ding'er, because the great army was far off, made no preparations;
translations.idiomatic: Ding'er, since the great army was far off, made no preparations;

sentences.zh: 亮先豎一纛於近城高嶺，自將二十騎馳入城。

translations.literal: Liang first raised a banner on a high ridge near the city, then himself led twenty horse galloping into the city.
translations.idiomatic: Liang first raised a banner on a high ridge near the city, then himself commanded twenty horse galloping into the city.

sentences.zh: 定兒方置酒，眾猝見亮至，駭愕，不知所為，亮麾兵斬定兒，遙指城外纛，命二騎曰：「出召大軍！

translations.literal: Ding'er was just setting out wine. The host, suddenly seeing Liang arrive, were startled and did not know what to do. Liang waved his troops to behead Ding'er, pointed afar at the banner outside the city, and ordered two horsemen, saying, "Go summon the great army!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Ding'er was just setting out wine. The host, suddenly seeing Liang arrive, were startled and did not know what to do. Liang waved his troops to behead Ding'er, pointed afar at the banner outside the city, and ordered two horsemen, saying, "Go summon the great army!"

sentences.zh: 」城中皆懾服，莫敢動。

translations.literal: " All in the city were cowed and submitted; none dared move.
translations.idiomatic: " All in the city were cowed and submitted; none dared move, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 23先是，故氐王楊紹先乘魏亂逃歸武興，復稱王。

translations.literal: Earlier, the former Di king Yang Shaoxian, taking advantage of Wei disorder, had fled back to Wuxing and again styled himself king.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, the former Di king Yang Shaoxian, taking advantage of Wei disorder, had fled back to Wuxing and again styled himself king.

sentences.zh: 涼州刺史李叔仁為其民所執，氐、羌、吐谷渾所在蜂起，自南岐至瓜、鄯，跨州據郡者不可勝數。

translations.literal: Inspector Li Shuren of Liangzhou was seized by his people. Di, Qiang, and Tuyuhun rose everywhere like bees; from Southern Qi to Guazhou and Shazhou, those who held provinces and commanderies across the land were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Li Shuren of Liangzhou was seized by his people. Di, Qiang, and Tuyuhun rose everywhere like bees; from Southern Qi to Guazhou and Shazhou, those who held provinces and commanderies across the land were beyond counting, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 宇文泰令李弼鎮原州，夏州刺史拔也惡蚝鎮南秦州，渭州刺史可朱渾道元鎮渭州，衛將軍趙貴行秦州事，征豳、涇、東秦、岐四州之粟以給軍。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai ordered Li Bi to hold Yuanzhou, Baye Ehao to hold Southern Qinzhou, Kezhuhun Daoyuan to hold Weizhou, Military Guard General Zhao Gui to act for Qinzhou, and levied grain from Bin, Jing, Eastern Qin, and Qi to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai ordered Li Bi to hold Yuanzhou, Baye Ehao to hold Southern Qinzhou, Kezhuhun Daoyuan to hold Weizhou, Military Guard General Zhao Gui to act for Qinzhou, and levied grain from Bin, Jing, Eastern Qin, and Qi to supply the army, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 楊紹先懼，稱籓，送妻子為質。

translations.literal: Yang Shaoxian was afraid, submitted as vassal, and sent wife and children as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shaoxian was afraid, submitted as vassal, and dispatched wife and children as hostages.

sentences.zh: 24夏州長史於謹言於泰曰：「明公據關中險固之地，將士驍勇，土地膏腴。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk Yu Jin of Xia province said to Tai, "My lord holds the secure and strategic land of Guanzhong; officers and soldiers are fierce; the soil is rich.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk Yu Jin of Xia province told Tai, "My lord holds the secure and strategic land of Guanzhong; officers and soldiers are fierce; the soil is rich.

sentences.zh: 今天子在洛，迫於群凶，若陳明公之懇誠，算時事之利害，請都關右，挾天子以令諸侯，奉王命以討暴亂，此桓、文之業，千載一時也！

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven is at Luoyang, pressed by evil men. If you set forth my lord's sincere intent and reckon the gains and losses of the times, ask to move the capital to the right of Pass, hold the Son of Heaven to command the feudal lords, and obey the royal mandate to punish violence—this is the achievement of Duke Huan and Duke Wen; a moment in a thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, The Son of Heaven is at Luoyang, pressed by evil men. If you set forth my lord's sincere intent and reckon the gains and losses of the times, ask to move the capital to the right of Pass, hold the Son of Heaven to command the feudal lords, and obey the royal mandate to punish violence—this is the achievement of Duke Huan and Duke Wen; a moment in a thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 」泰善之。

translations.literal: " Tai approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Tai approved.

sentences.zh: 丞相歡聞泰定秦、隴，遣使甘言厚禮以結之，泰不受，封其書，使都督濟北張軌獻於魏主。

translations.literal: Chancellor Huan heard that Tai had settled Qin and Long and sent envoys with sweet words and rich gifts to win him. Tai would not accept, sealed the letter, and had Supervisor Zhang Gui of Jibei present it to the Wei sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan heard that Tai had settled Qin and Long and dispatched envoys with sweet words and rich gifts to win him. Tai would not accept, sealed the letter, and had Supervisor Zhang Gui of Jibei present it to the Wei sovereign.

sentences.zh: 斛斯椿問軌曰：「高歡逆謀，行路皆知之。

translations.literal: Husu Chun asked Gui, "Gao Huan's rebellious design is known to travelers on every road.
translations.idiomatic: Husu Chun asked Gui, "Gao Huan's rebellious design is known to travelers on every road, the annals record.
