sentences.zh: 人情所恃，唯在西方，未知宇文何如賀拔！

translations.literal: Men's hopes rest only on the west; it is not known how Yuwen compares with Heba!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Men's hopes rest only on the west; it is not known how Yuwen compares with Heba!"

sentences.zh: 」軌曰：「宇文公文足經國，武能定亂。

translations.literal: Gui said, "Lord Yuwen's writing suffices to order the state; his martial ability can settle disorder."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Gui said, "Lord Yuwen's writing suffices to order the state; his martial ability can settle disorder."

sentences.zh: 」椿曰：「誠如君言，真可恃也。

translations.literal: " Chun said, "Truly as you say—he can indeed be relied on."
translations.idiomatic: " Husu Chun said, "Truly as you say—he can indeed be relied on."

sentences.zh: 25魏主命泰發二千騎鎮東雍州，助為勢援，仍命泰稍引軍而東。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign ordered Tai to send two thousand horse to garrison Eastern Yongzhou as a supporting force and also ordered Tai gradually to lead troops east.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor ordered Tai to send two thousand horse to garrison Eastern Yongzhou as a supporting force and also ordered Tai gradually to lead troops east.

sentences.zh: 泰以大都督武川梁御為雍州刺史，使將步騎五千前行。

translations.literal: Tai made Liang Yu of Wuchuan inspector of Yongzhou and had him lead five thousand foot and horse ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai made Liang Yu of Wuchuan inspector of Yongzhou and had him lead five thousand foot and horse ahead.

sentences.zh: 先是，丞相歡遣其都督太安韓軌將兵一萬據蒲板以救侯莫陳悅，凝州刺史賈顯度以舟迎之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Chancellor Huan had sent his supervisor Han Gui of Tai'an with ten thousand troops to hold Puban to rescue Hou Mo Chen Yue; Inspector Jia Xiandu of Ningzhou received him with boats.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Chancellor Huan had dispatched his supervisor Han Gui of Tai'an with ten thousand troops to hold Puban to rescue Hou Mo Chen Yue; Inspector Jia Xiandu of Ningzhou received him with boats.

sentences.zh: 梁御見顯度，說使從泰，顯度即出迎御，御入據長安。

translations.literal: When Liang Yu saw Xiandu, he persuaded him to follow Tai; Xiandu at once came out to welcome Yu, and Yu entered and held Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Liang Yu saw Xiandu, he persuaded him to follow Tai; Xiandu immediately came out to welcome Yu, and Yu entered and held Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 魏主以泰為侍中、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、關西大都督、略陽縣公，承製封拜。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign made Tai Palace Attendant, Grand General Who Campaigns on Horseback, Bearer of the Staff with Equal Rank to the Three Dukes, Grand Commander of Guanxi, and Duke of Lueyang, with authority to enfeoff and appoint by provisional edict.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor made Tai Palace Attendant, Grand General Who Campaigns on Horseback, Bearer of the Staff with Equal Rank to the Three Dukes, Grand Commander of Guanxi, and Duke of Lueyang, with authority to enfeoff and appoint by provisional edict.

sentences.zh: 泰乃以寇洛為涇州刺史，李弼為秦州刺史，前略陽太守張獻為南岐州刺史。

translations.literal: Tai then made Kou Luo inspector of Jingzhou, Li Bi inspector of Qinzhou, and former Administrator Zhang Xian of Lueyang inspector of Southern Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai then made Kou Luo inspector of Jingzhou, Li Bi inspector of Qinzhou, and former Administrator Zhang Xian of Lueyang inspector of Southern Qi.

sentences.zh: 南岐州刺史盧待伯不受代，泰遣輕騎襲而擒之。

translations.literal: Lu Daibo, inspector of Southern Qi, would not accept replacement; Tai sent light horse in a surprise attack and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Daibo, inspector of Southern Qi, would not accept replacement; Tai dispatched light horse in a surprise attack and took him.

sentences.zh: 26侍中封隆之言於丞相歡曰：「斛斯椿等今在京師，必構禍亂。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Feng Longzhi said to Chancellor Huan, "Husu Chun and the others are now in the capital and will surely stir up calamity and disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Feng Longzhi told Chancellor Huan, "Husu Chun and the others are now in the capital and will surely stir up calamity and disorder."

sentences.zh: 」隆之與僕射孫騰爭尚魏主妹平原公主，公主歸隆之，騰洩其言於椿，椿以白帝。

translations.literal: " Longzhi and Vice Director Sun Teng vied to marry the emperor's younger sister the Princess of Pingyuan; the princess went to Longzhi, and Teng leaked his words to Chun, who reported to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: " Longzhi and Vice Director Sun Teng vied to marry the emperor's younger sister the Princess of Pingyuan; the princess went to Longzhi, and Teng leaked his words to Chun, who reported to the emperor, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 隆之懼，逃還鄉里，歡召隆之詣晉陽。

translations.literal: Longzhi was afraid, fled to his home district, and Huan summoned Longzhi to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Longzhi was afraid, fled to his home district, and Huan summoned Longzhi to Jinyang, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 會騰帶仗入省，擅殺御史，懼罪，亦逃就歡。

translations.literal: At that time Teng entered the Secretariat bearing arms and on his own authority killed a censor. Fearing punishment, he too fled to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Teng entered the Secretariat bearing arms and on his own authority killed a censor. Fearing punishment, he too fled to Huan, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 領軍婁昭辭疾歸晉陽。

translations.literal: Commander of the Guards Lou Zhao pleaded illness and returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of the Guards Lou Zhao pleaded illness and returned to Jinyang, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 帝以斛斯椿兼領軍，改置都督及河南、關西諸刺史。

translations.literal: The emperor made Husu Chun also Commander of the Guards and reorganized supervisors and the inspectors of Henan and Guanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign made Husu Chun also Commander of the Guards and reorganized supervisors and the inspectors of Henan and Guanxi.

sentences.zh: 華山王鷙在徐州，歡使大都督邸珍奪其管鑰。

translations.literal: Prince Zhi of Huashan was at Xuzhou; Huan sent Grand Commander Di Zhen to seize his keys of office.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhi of Huashan was at Xuzhou; Huan dispatched Grand Commander Di Zhen to seize his keys of office.

sentences.zh: 建州刺史韓賢，濟州刺史蔡俊，皆歡黨也。

translations.literal: Inspector Han Xian of Jianzhou and Inspector Cai Jun of Jizhou were both Huan's partisans.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Han Xian of Jianzhou and Inspector Cai Jun of Jizhou were both Huan's partisans, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 帝省建州以去賢，使御史舉俊罪，以汝陽王叔昭代之。

translations.literal: The emperor abolished Jianzhou to remove Xian and had the censorate impeach Jun, replacing him with Prince Shuzhao of Ruyang.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign abolished Jianzhou to remove Xian and had the censorate impeach Jun, replacing him with Prince Shuzhao of Ruyang.

sentences.zh: 歡上言：「俊勳重，不可解奪；

translations.literal: Huan memorialized, saying, "Jun's merit is weighty and cannot be removed from office;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan memorialized, saying, "Jun's merit is weighty and cannot be removed from office;

sentences.zh: 汝陽懿德，當受大籓；

translations.literal: Ruyang has virtuous conduct and should receive a great fief;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Ruyang has virtuous conduct and should receive a great fief;

sentences.zh: 臣弟永寶，猥任定州，宜避賢路。

translations.literal: my younger brother Yongbao unworthily holds Dingzhou and ought to yield the path for the worthy."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, my younger brother Yongbao unworthily holds Dingzhou and ought to yield the path for the worthy."

sentences.zh: 」帝不聽。

translations.literal: " The emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor refused to listen.

sentences.zh: 27五月丙子，魏主增置勳府庶子，廂別六百人；

translations.literal: On bingzi in the fifth month, the Wei sovereign added aides in the Merit Office, six hundred per wing;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, On bingzi in the fifth month, the Wei sovereign added aides in the Merit Office, six hundred per wing;

sentences.zh: 又增騎官，廂別二百人。

translations.literal: he also added cavalry officers, two hundred per wing.
translations.idiomatic: he also added cavalry officers, two hundred per wing, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 28魏主欲伐晉陽，辛卯，下詔戒嚴，雲欲自將伐梁。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign wished to attack Jinyang. On xinmao he issued an edict putting the realm on alert, saying he would personally lead a campaign against Liang.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor wished to attack Jinyang. On xinmao he issued an edict putting the realm on alert, saying he would personally lead a campaign against Liang.

sentences.zh: 發河南諸州兵，大閱於洛陽，南臨洛水，北際邙山，帝戎服與斛斯椿臨觀之。

translations.literal: He mobilized troops from the provinces of Henan, held a great review at Luoyang, south facing the Luo River and north reaching Mount Mang; the emperor in martial dress watched with Husu Chun.
translations.idiomatic: He mobilized troops from the provinces of Henan, held a great review at Luoyang, south facing the Luo River and north reaching Mount Mang; the emperor in martial dress watched with Husu Chun, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 29六月丁巳，魏主密詔丞相歡，稱「宇文黑獺、賀拔勝頗有異志，故假稱南伐，潛為之備；

translations.literal: On dingsi in the sixth month the Wei sovereign secretly instructed Chancellor Huan, saying, "Yuwen Heitai and Heba Sheng harbor rebellious intent; therefore under pretense of southern campaign I secretly prepare against them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the sixth month the Wei sovereign secretly instructed Chancellor Huan, saying, "Yuwen Heitai and Heba Sheng harbor rebellious intent; therefore under pretense of southern campaign I secretly prepare against them, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 王亦宜共為形援。

translations.literal: The king too ought jointly to be a visible support.
translations.idiomatic: The king too ought jointly to be a visible support, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 讀訖燔之。

translations.literal: When read, burn it."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, When read, burn it."

sentences.zh: 」歡表以為「荊、雍將有逆謀，臣今潛勒兵馬三萬，自河東渡，又遣恆州刺史庫狄乾等將兵四萬自來違津渡，領軍將軍婁昭等將兵五萬以討荊州，冀州刺史尉景等將山東兵五萬、突騎五萬以討江左，皆勒所部，伏聽處分。

translations.literal: " Huan memorialized in reply that "Jing and Yong will have a rebellious plot. Your servant now secretly arrays thirty thousand troops to cross from Hedong, and also sends Kudi Gan of Hengzhou and others with forty thousand troops to cross from Laiwei Ford, Commander of the Guards Lou Zhao and others with fifty thousand to campaign against Jingzhou, and Inspector Wei Jing and others with fifty thousand Shandong troops and fifty thousand shock cavalry to campaign against the Jiang left—all drilling their commands and awaiting orders."
translations.idiomatic: " Huan memorialized in reply that "Jing and Yong will have a rebellious plot. translations.literal: Now observing their conduct, there is no other trace.
translations.idiomatic: Now observing their conduct, there is no other trace, the annals record.

translations.literal: The southeast has long not submitted; today the realm's households are halved—we ought not exhaust arms to the limit.

translations.literal: We are ourselves dim; we do not know who the slanderers are.
translations.idiomatic: We are ourselves dim; we do not know who the slanderers are, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 頃高乾之死，豈獨朕意！

translations.literal: The recent death of Gao Gan—was it only our intent!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, The recent death of Gao Gan—was it only our intent!

translations.literal: The king suddenly told Ang that your elder brother died wrongfully—how easily men's eyes and ears may be misled!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, The king suddenly told Ang that your elder brother died wrongfully—how easily men's eyes and ears may be misled!

translations.idiomatic: We hear Kudi Gan told the king, "We originally wished to take a weakling as sovereign; without cause we set up this elder lord, making him unmanageable, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 今但作十五日行，自可廢之，更立餘者。

sentences.zh: 』如此議論，自是王間勳人，豈出佞臣之口！

translations.idiomatic: In sum, Such talk is surely among the king's meritorious men—how could it come from slanderers' mouths!

translations.literal: Last year Feng Longzhi rebelled; this year Sun Teng fled—neither punished nor sent back; who does not wonder at the king!
translations.idiomatic: Last year Feng Longzhi rebelled; this year Sun Teng fled—neither punished nor dispatched back; who does not wonder at the king!

sentences.zh: 王若事君盡誠，何不斬送二首！

translations.literal: If the king serves the ruler with full loyalty, why not behead and send the two heads!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If the king serves the ruler with full loyalty, why not behead and send the two heads!

sentences.zh: 王雖啟云『西去』，而四道俱進，或欲南度洛陽，或欲東臨江左，言之者猶應自怪，聞之者寧能不疑！

translations.literal: Though the king reports "going west," four routes advance together—perhaps wishing to cross south to Luoyang, perhaps wishing to press east to the Jiang left. Those who speak of it should themselves find it strange; those who hear cannot but doubt!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Though the king reports "going west," four routes advance together—perhaps wishing to cross south to Luoyang, perhaps wishing to press east to the Jiang left. Those who speak of it should themselves find it strange; those who hear cannot but doubt!

sentences.zh: 王若晏然居北，在此雖有百萬之眾，終無圖彼之心；

translations.literal: If the king sits calmly in the north, here though there be a million men, in the end there is no mind to scheme against him;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If the king sits calmly in the north, here though there be a million men, in the end there is no mind to scheme against him;

sentences.zh: 王若舉旗南指，縱無匹馬只輪，猶欲奮空拳而爭死。

translations.literal: if the king raises his banner south, though there be not a horse or wheel, we still wish to strike with empty fists and fight to the death.
translations.idiomatic: if the king raises his banner south, though there be not a horse or wheel, we still wish to strike with empty fists and fight to the death, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 朕本寡德，王已立之。

translations.literal: We were originally of meager virtue; the king already set us up.
translations.idiomatic: We were originally of meager virtue; the king already set us up, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 百姓無知，或謂實可。

translations.literal: The people are without understanding; some say it was truly possible.
translations.idiomatic: The people are without understanding; some say it was truly possible, the annals record.

translations.literal: If others scheme against us, then our wickedness is shown;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If others scheme against us, then our wickedness is shown;

sentences.zh: 假令還為王殺，幽辱齏粉，了無遺恨！

translations.literal: even if we should in turn be killed by the king, hidden shame and crushed powder—we would have no regret!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, even if we should in turn be killed by the king, hidden shame and crushed powder—we would have no regret!

translations.literal: We originally hoped ruler and minister would be one body, as if tally halves matched—we did not think today we would be estranged to this point!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, We originally hoped ruler and minister would be one body, as if tally halves matched—we did not think today we would be estranged to this point!"

translations.idiomatic: " Military Guard General Wang Sizheng told the Wei sovereign, "Gao Huan's heart is clear as if seen in daylight.

translations.idiomatic: Sheng asked Grand Tutor Staff Member Lu Rou of Fanyang. Rou said, "Gao Huan is rebellious. Your Grace should sweep to the capital, decide victory or defeat with him, and stake life on it—that is the upper plan;

translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan summoned his younger brother Chen, inspector of Dingzhou, to hold Jinyang and ordered Chief Clerk Cui Xian to assist him.

translations.literal: Xian was a clansman several generations removed from Ting.
translations.idiomatic: Xian was a clansman several generations removed from Ting, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歡勒兵南出，告其眾曰：「孤以爾朱擅命，建大義於海內，奉戴主上，誠貫幽明；

translations.literal: Huan led troops south and told his host, "I raised great righteousness within the seas against the Erzhu for seizing power, bore the Son of Heaven on high with sincerity penetrating dark and bright;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan commanded troops south and told his host, "I raised great righteousness within the seas against the Erzhu for seizing power, bore the Son of Heaven on high with sincerity penetrating dark and bright;

sentences.zh: 橫為斛斯椿讒構，以忠為逆，今者南邁，誅椿而已。

translations.literal: I have been slandered by Husu Chun and turned loyal into rebellion. Today's march south is only to execute Chun."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, I have been slandered by Husu Chun and turned loyal into rebellion. Today's march south is only to execute Chun."

sentences.zh: 」以高敖曹為前鋒。

translations.literal: " He made Gao Aocao vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: " He made Gao Aocao vanguard, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 宇文泰亦移檄州郡，數歡罪惡，自將大軍發高平，前軍屯弘農。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai also circulated a proclamation through provinces and commanderies counting Huan's crimes, himself led a great army from Gaoping, and advanced troops encamped at Hongnong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai also circulated a proclamation through provinces and commanderies counting Huan's crimes, himself commanded a great army from Gaoping, and advanced troops encamped at Hongnong.

sentences.zh: 賀拔勝軍於汝水。

translations.literal: Heba Sheng encamped along the Ru River.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Sheng encamped along the Ru River, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 35秋七月己丑，魏主親勒兵十餘萬屯河橋，以斛斯椿為前驅，陳於邙山之北。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jichou, the Wei sovereign personally led more than a hundred thousand troops and encamped at Heqiao, with Husu Chun as vanguard, arrayed north of Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jichou, the Wei sovereign personally commanded more than a hundred thousand troops and encamped at Heqiao, with Husu Chun as vanguard, arrayed north of Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 椿請帥精騎二千夜度河掩其勞弊，帝始然之。

translations.literal: Chun asked to lead two thousand picked horse by night across the river to strike their weary troops; the emperor at first agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Chun asked to lead two thousand picked horse by night across the river to strike their weary troops; the emperor at first agreed, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎楊寬說帝曰：「高歡以臣伐君，何所不至！

translations.literal: Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Yang Kuan said to the emperor, "Gao Huan as subject attacking ruler—what would he not do!
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Yang Kuan told the emperor, "Gao Huan as subject attacking ruler—what would he not do!

sentences.zh: 今假兵於人，恐生它變。

translations.literal: To lend troops to others now may breed other changes.
translations.idiomatic: To lend troops to others now may breed other changes, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 椿若度河，萬一有功，是滅一高歡，生一高歡矣。

translations.literal: If Chun crosses the river and by chance succeeds, that is destroying one Gao Huan and begetting another Gao Huan."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If Chun crosses the river and by chance succeeds, that is destroying one Gao Huan and begetting another Gao Huan."

sentences.zh: 」帝遂敕椿停行，椿歎曰：「頃熒惑入南斗，今上信左右間構，不用吾計，豈天道乎！

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered Chun to halt. Chun sighed, "Recently Mars entered the Southern Dipper; now the sovereign trusts slander from those at his side and will not use my plan—is this Heaven's way!"
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign then ordered Chun to halt. Chun sighed, "Recently Mars entered the Southern Dipper; now the sovereign trusts slander from those at his side and will not use my plan—is this Heaven's way!"

sentences.zh: 」宇文泰聞之，謂左右曰：「高歡數日行八九百里，此兵家所忌，當乘便擊之。

translations.literal: " When Yuwen Tai heard, he said to those at his side, "Gao Huan marches eight or nine hundred li in several days—this is what military strategists fear; we ought to seize the moment and strike.
translations.idiomatic: Once Yuwen Tai heard, he told those at his side, "Gao Huan marches eight or nine hundred li in several days—this is what military strategists fear; we ought to seize the moment and strike.

sentences.zh: 而主上以萬乘之重，不能度河決戰，方緣津據守。

translations.literal: Yet the sovereign with the weight of ten thousand chariots cannot cross the river for a decisive battle and only holds the ford and defends.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the sovereign with the weight of ten thousand chariots cannot cross the river for a decisive battle and only holds the ford and defends, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 且長河萬里，捍御為難。

translations.literal: Moreover the long river is ten thousand li—defense is hard.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the long river is ten thousand li—defense is hard, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 若一處得度，大事去矣。

translations.literal: If they get across at one place, the great affair is lost."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If they get across at one place, the great affair is lost."

sentences.zh: 」即以大都督趙貴為別道行台，自蒲板濟，趣并州，遣大都督李賢將精騎一千赴洛陽。

translations.literal: He at once made Zhao Gui mobile headquarters on a separate route, crossed from Puban toward Bingzhou, and sent Li Xian with a thousand picked horse to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately made Zhao Gui mobile headquarters on a separate route, crossed from Puban toward Bingzhou, and dispatched Li Xian with a thousand picked horse to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 36帝使斛斯椿與行台長孫稚、大都督穎川王斌之鎮虎牢，行台長孫子彥鎮陝，賈顯智、斛斯元壽鎮滑台。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Husu Chun with Mobile Headquarters Changsun Zhi and Grand Commander Wang Binzhi of Yingchuan to hold Hulao, Changsun Ziyan to hold Shaan, Jia Xianzhi and Husu Yuanshou to hold Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign dispatched Husu Chun with Mobile Headquarters Changsun Zhi and Grand Commander Wang Binzhi of Yingchuan to hold Hulao, Changsun Ziyan to hold Shaan, Jia Xianzhi and Husu Yuanshou to hold Huatai.

sentences.zh: 斌之，鑒之弟；

translations.literal: Binzhi was a younger brother of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: Binzhi was a younger brother of Jian, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 子彥，稚之子也。

translations.literal: Ziyan was Zhi's son.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Ziyan was Zhi's son.

sentences.zh: 歡使相州刺史竇泰趣滑台，建州刺史韓賢趣石濟。

translations.literal: Huan sent Inspector Dou Tai to hurry to Huatai and Inspector Han Xian to hurry to Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan dispatched Inspector Dou Tai to hurry to Huatai and Inspector Han Xian to hurry to Shiji.

sentences.zh: 竇泰與顯智遇於長壽津，顯智陰約降於歡，引軍退。

translations.literal: Dou Tai met Xianzhi at Changshou Ford; Xianzhi secretly agreed to surrender to Huan and led his army back.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Tai met Xianzhi at Changshou Ford; Xianzhi secretly agreed to surrender to Huan and commanded his army back.

sentences.zh: 軍司元玄覺之，馳還，請益師，帝遣大都督侯鰤紹赴之，戰於滑台東，顯智以軍降，紹戰死。

translations.literal: Army Supervisor Yuan Xuan perceived it, galloped back, and asked for more troops. The emperor sent Grand Commander Hou Shao to help; they fought east of Huatai. Xianzhi surrendered his army with flags; Shao died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Army Supervisor Yuan Xuan perceived it, galloped back, and asked for more troops. The emperor dispatched Grand Commander Hou Shao to help; they fought east of Huatai. Xianzhi submitted his army with flags; Shao died in battle.

sentences.zh: 北中郎將田怙為歡內應，歡潛軍至野王，帝知之，斬怙。

translations.literal: Northern Center General Tian Yi was Huan's agent within. Huan secretly led troops to Wild King; the emperor learned and beheaded Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Center General Tian Yi was Huan's agent within. Huan secretly commanded troops to Wild King; the emperor learned and beheaded Yi.

sentences.zh: 歡至河北十餘里，再遣使口申誠款；

translations.literal: Huan reached within ten-odd li north of the river and again sent envoys orally declaring sincere intent; the emperor did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan reached within ten-odd li north of the river and again dispatched envoys orally declaring sincere intent; the emperor did not reply.

sentences.zh: 帝不報。

translations.literal: The emperor did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign did not reply.

sentences.zh: 丙午，歡引軍度河。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Huan led his army across the river.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Huan commanded his army across the river.

sentences.zh: 37魏主問計於群臣，或欲奔梁，或雲南依賀拔勝，或云西就關中，或云守洛口死戰，計未決。

translations.literal: The Wei sovereign asked the hundred officials for plans. Some wished to flee to Liang, some said to rely on Heba Sheng in the south, some to go west to Guanzhong, some to hold Luokou and fight to the death—no plan was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor asked the hundred officials for plans. Some wished to flee to Liang, some told rely on Heba Sheng in the south, some to go west to Guanzhong, some to hold Luokou and fight to the death—no plan was settled.

sentences.zh: 元斌之與斛斯椿爭權，棄椿還，紿帝云：「高歡兵已至！

translations.literal: Yuan Binzhi quarreled with Husu Chun over power, abandoned Chun and returned, and deceived the emperor, saying, "Gao Huan's troops have already arrived!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Yuan Binzhi quarreled with Husu Chun over power, abandoned Chun and returned, and deceived the emperor, saying, "Gao Huan's troops have already arrived!"

sentences.zh: 」丁未，帝遣使召椿還，遂帥南陽王寶炬、清河王但、廣陽王湛以五千騎宿於瀍西，南陽王別捨沙門惠臻負璽持千牛刀以從。

translations.literal: On dingwei the emperor sent to recall Chun, then led the Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju, Prince Dan of Qinghe, and Prince Zhan of Guangyang with five thousand horse to lodge west of the Chan. The Prince of Nanyang's separate lodging monk Huizhen carried the seal and held the thousand-bushel blade to follow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor dispatched to recall Chun, then commanded the Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju, Prince Dan of Qinghe, and Prince Zhan of Guangyang with five thousand horse to lodge west of the Chan. The Prince of Nanyang's separate lodging monk Huizhen carried the seal and held the thousand-bushel blade to follow.

sentences.zh: 眾知帝將西出，其夜，亡者過半，但、湛亦逃歸。

translations.literal: The host knew the emperor would go west; that night more than half fled. Dan and Zhan also fled home. Zhan was a son of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: The host knew the emperor would go west; that night more than half fled. Dan and Zhan also fled home. Zhan was a son of Shen, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 湛，深之子也。

translations.literal: Zhan was a son of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan was a son of Shen, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 武衛將軍雲中獨孤信單騎追帝，帝歎曰：「將軍辭父母、捐妻子而來，『世亂識忠臣』，豈虛言也！

translations.literal: Military Guard General Dugu Xin of Yunzhong pursued the emperor alone on horse. The emperor sighed, "General, you left parents and cast aside wife and children to come—'in chaotic ages one knows loyal ministers'—was that an empty saying!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Military Guard General Dugu Xin of Yunzhong pursued the emperor alone on horse. The emperor sighed, "General, you left parents and cast aside wife and children to come—'in chaotic ages one knows loyal ministers'—was that an empty saying!"

sentences.zh: 」戊申，帝西奔長安，李賢遇帝於崤中。

translations.literal: On wushen the emperor fled west to Chang'an. Li Xian met the emperor in the Xiao Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor fled west to Chang'an. Li Xian met the emperor in the Xiao Mountains, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 己酉，歡入洛陽，捨於永寧寺，遣領軍婁昭等追帝，請帝東還。

translations.literal: On jiyou Huan entered Luoyang, lodged at Yongning Temple, and sent Commander of the Guards Lou Zhao and others to pursue the emperor, asking the emperor to return east.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Huan entered Luoyang, lodged at Yongning Temple, and dispatched Commander of the Guards Lou Zhao and others to pursue the emperor, asking the emperor to return east.

sentences.zh: 長孫子彥不能守陝，棄城走。

translations.literal: Changsun Ziyan could not hold Shaan and abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Ziyan could not hold Shaan and abandoned the city and fled, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 高敖曹帥勁騎追帝至陝西，不及。

translations.literal: Gao Aocao led picked horse in pursuit to west of Shaan but did not overtake.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Aocao commanded picked horse in pursuit to west of Shaan but did not overtake.

sentences.zh: 帝鞭馬長鶩，糗漿乏絕，三二日間，從官唯飲澗水。

translations.literal: The emperor whipped his horse in long flight; provisions were exhausted. For two or three days attendants drank only stream water.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign whipped his horse in long flight; provisions were exhausted. For two or three days attendants drank only stream water.

sentences.zh: 至湖城，有王思村民以麥飯壺漿獻帝，帝悅，復一村十年。

translations.literal: At Hucheng, a villager named Wang Si offered millet meal and pot wine; the emperor was pleased and remitted one village ten years' tax.
translations.idiomatic: At Hucheng, a villager named Wang Si offered millet meal and pot wine; the emperor was pleased and remitted one village ten years' tax, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 至稠桑，潼關大都督毛鴻賓迎獻酒食，從官始解飢渴。

translations.literal: At Chousang, Tongguan Grand Commander Mao Hongbin came to welcome and offered food and drink; attendants at last eased hunger and thirst.
translations.idiomatic: At Chousang, Tongguan Grand Commander Mao Hongbin came to welcome and offered food and drink; attendants at last eased hunger and thirst, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 38八月甲寅，丞相歡集百官謂曰：「為臣奉主，匡救危亂，若處不諫爭，出不陪從，緩則耽寵爭榮，急則委之逃竄，臣節安在！

translations.literal: On jiayin in the eighth month, Chancellor Huan assembled the hundred officials and said, "As ministers serving a ruler, one ought to rescue danger and disorder. If in council one does not remonstrate, in going out one does not accompany, in ease one clings to favor and fights for glory, in urgency one abandons and flees—where is the minister's integrity!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, On jiayin in the eighth month, Chancellor Huan assembled the hundred officials and said, "As ministers serving a ruler, one ought to rescue danger and disorder. translations.idiomatic: None could answer. Concurrent Left Vice Director Xin Xiong said, "The sovereign plotted affairs with those close to him; Xiong and others could not hear in advance, the annals record.

translations.idiomatic: In sum, When the imperial carriage went west, if we had followed at once, we feared the trace would be the same as the flatterers' party;

sentences.zh: 留待大王，又以不從蒙責，雄等進退無所逃罪。

translations.literal: to stay and await Your Lordship was again to be blamed for not following. Xiong and others had nowhere to escape guilt in advance or retreat."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, to stay and await Your Lordship was again to be blamed for not following. Xiong and others had nowhere to escape guilt in advance or retreat."

translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan said, "You all fill ministerial posts and ought to give your persons for the state. When flatterers held power, did you ever speak one word of remonstrance!

sentences.zh: 群佞用事，卿等嘗有一言諫爭乎！

translations.literal: To bring the state's affairs in one morning to this—upon whom do you wish to lay the crime!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, To bring the state's affairs in one morning to this—upon whom do you wish to lay the crime!"

sentences.zh: 使國家之事一朝至此，罪欲何歸！

translations.literal: He then seized Xiong and Bearer of the Staff Chilie Yanching, Concurrent Minister of Personnel Cui Xiaofen, Minister of Justice Liu Zhi, Concurrent Minister of Revenue Yang Ji of Tianshui, and Palace Attendant Yuan Shibi—and killed them all.
translations.idiomatic: He then seized Xiong and Bearer of the Staff Chilie Yanching, Concurrent Minister of Personnel Cui Xiaofen, Minister of Justice Liu Zhi, Concurrent Minister of Revenue Yang Ji of Tianshui, and Palace Attendant Yuan Shibi—and killed them all, the annals record.

translations.literal: Xiaofen's son Langyou, a gentleman in the Masters of Writing, entered Guanxi by secret route; the Wei sovereign had him memorialize for the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaofen's son Langyou, a gentleman in the Masters of Writing, entered Guanxi by secret route; the Wei sovereign had him memorialize for the Secretariat, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 孝芬子司徒從事中朗猷間行入關，魏主使以本官奏門下事。

translations.literal: Huan advanced Prince Dan of Qinghe to Minister of Works, decided affairs by provisional edict, and dwelt in the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan advanced Prince Dan of Qinghe to Minister of Works, decided affairs by provisional edict, and dwelt in the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 歡推司徒清河王但為大司馬，承製決事，居尚書省。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai sent Zhao Gui and Liang Yu with two thousand armored horse to welcome. The emperor followed the west bank of the river and said to Yu, "This water flows east while We go up west.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai dispatched Zhao Gui and Liang Yu with two thousand armored horse to welcome. The emperor followed the west bank of the river and told Yu, "This water flows east while We go up west.

sentences.zh: 39宇文泰使趙貴、梁御帥甲騎二千奉迎，帝循河西行，謂御曰：「此水東流，而朕西上。

translations.literal: If We can again see Luoyang and personally visit the tombs and temples, it is your merit."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If We can again see Luoyang and personally visit the tombs and temples, it is your merit."

sentences.zh: 若得復見洛陽，親詣陵廟，卿等功也。

translations.literal: The emperor and those at his side all wept.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign and those at his side all wept.

sentences.zh: 」帝及左右皆流涕。

translations.literal: Tai prepared guards of honor to welcome the emperor and met him at Dongyang Post. Removing his cap he wept, saying, "Your servant could not restrain the ravaging invader and caused the imperial carriage to wander—your servant's crime."
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai prepared guards of honor to welcome the emperor and met him at Dongyang Post. Removing his cap he wept, saying, "Your servant could not restrain the ravaging invader and caused the imperial carriage to wander—your servant's crime."

sentences.zh: 泰備儀衛迎帝，謁見於東陽驛，免冠流涕曰：「臣不能式遏寇虐，使乘輿播遷，臣之罪也。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Your loyalty and integrity are renowned far and near. We, of meager virtue, lost the chariot and brought on invaders—today's meeting deeply shames Us.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign said, "Your loyalty and integrity are renowned far and near. We, of meager virtue, lost the chariot and brought on invaders—today's meeting deeply shames Us.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「公之忠節，著於遐邇。

translations.literal: We now entrust the altars of state to you—do your utmost!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, We now entrust the altars of state to you—do your utmost!"

sentences.zh: 朕以不德，負乘致寇，今日相見，深用厚顏。

translations.literal: I lack virtue and brought calamity by misrule; meeting today, I am deeply ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: I lack virtue and brought calamity by misrule; meeting today, I am deeply ashamed, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 方以社稷委公，公其勉之！

translations.literal: We now entrust the altars of state to you—do your utmost!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, We now entrust the altars of state to you—do your utmost!"

sentences.zh: 」將士皆呼萬歲。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers all shouted ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers all shouted ten thousand years, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 遂入長安，以雍州廨捨為宮，大赦。

translations.literal: They then entered Chang'an, used Yongzhou offices as the palace, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: They then entered Chang'an, used Yongzhou offices as the palace, and proclaimed a general amnesty, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 以泰為大將軍、雍州刺史，兼尚書令。

translations.literal: Tai was made Grand General and inspector of Yongzhou, concurrent Chief of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai became Grand General and inspector of Yongzhou, concurrent Chief of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 軍國之政，咸取決焉。

translations.literal: All military and state affairs were decided by him.
translations.idiomatic: All military and state affairs were decided by him, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 別置二尚書，分掌機事，以行台尚毛遐、周惠達為之。

translations.literal: He separately set two Masters of Writing to divide control of critical affairs, with Mobile Headquarters Shang Mao Xia and Zhou Huida.
translations.idiomatic: He separately set two Masters of Writing to divide control of critical affairs, with Mobile Headquarters Shang Mao Xia and Zhou Huida, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 時軍國草創，二人積糧儲，治器械，簡士馬，魏朝賴之。

translations.literal: At that time the state and army were newly founded; the two men accumulated grain stores, prepared weapons, and selected soldiers and horses—the Wei court relied on them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the state and army were newly founded; the two men accumulated grain stores, prepared weapons, and selected soldiers and horses—the Wei court relied on them, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 泰尚馮翊長公主，拜駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: Tai married the eldest princess of Fengyi and was made Commandant of the Horse Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai married the eldest princess of Fengyi and became Commandant of the Horse Guards.

sentences.zh: 40先是，熒惑入南斗，去而復還，留止六旬。

translations.literal: Earlier, Mars had entered the Southern Dipper, left and returned, and stayed six tens of days.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Mars had entered the Southern Dipper, left and returned, and stayed six tens of days.

sentences.zh: 上以諺云「熒惑入南斗，天子下殿走」，乃跣而下殿以禳之；

translations.literal: The Liang sovereign, because a proverb said "Mars enters the Southern Dipper, the Son of Heaven leaves the hall and runs," went barefoot down from the hall to avert it;
translations.idiomatic: The Liang sovereign, since a proverb said "Mars enters the Southern Dipper, the Son of Heaven leaves the hall and runs," went barefoot down from the hall to avert it;

sentences.zh: 及聞魏主西奔，慚曰：「虜亦應天象邪！

translations.literal: when he heard the Wei sovereign had fled west, he said in shame, "Do the northern barbarians also respond to heavenly signs!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, when he heard the Wei sovereign had fled west, he said in shame, "Do the northern barbarians also respond to heavenly signs!"

sentences.zh: 41己未，武興王楊紹先為秦、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Prince Shaoxian of Wuxing was made inspector of Qin and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Prince Shaoxian of Wuxing became inspector of Qin and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 42辛酉，魏丞相歡自追迎魏主。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Wei Chancellor Huan himself pursued to welcome the Wei sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wei Chancellor Huan himself pursued to welcome the Wei sovereign, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，清河王但下制大赦。

translations.literal: Huan reached Hongnong. In the ninth month, on guisi, he sent Mobile Headquarters Vice Director Yuan Zisi to lead palace attendants to welcome the emperor;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan reached Hongnong. In the ninth month, on guisi, he dispatched Mobile Headquarters Vice Director Yuan Zisi to lead palace attendants to welcome the emperor;

sentences.zh: 歡至弘農，九月，癸巳，使行台僕射元子思帥侍官迎帝；

translations.literal: on jiyou he attacked Tongguan, took it, captured Mao Hongbin, advanced and encamped at the Long Wall of Huayin; Longmen supervisor Xue Chongli surrendered his city to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: on jiyou he struck Tongguan, took it, took Mao Hongbin, advanced and encamped at the Long Wall of Huayin; Longmen supervisor Xue Chongli submitted his city to Huan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，攻潼關，克之，擒毛鴻賓，進屯華陰長城，龍門都督薛崇禮以城降歡。

translations.literal: Heba Sheng had Chief Clerk Yuan Ying act for Jingzhou affairs and hold Nanyang; he himself led his command west toward Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Sheng had Chief Clerk Yuan Ying act for Jingzhou affairs and hold Nanyang; he himself commanded his command west toward Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 43賀拔勝使長史元穎行荊州事，守南陽，自帥所部西赴關中。

translations.literal: Reaching Xiyang, he heard Huan had already encamped at Huayin and wished to return. Mobile Headquarters Left Director Cui Qian said, "Today the imperial house is overturned and the sovereign suffers dust; my lord ought to march day and night, attend the traveling court, then with Yuwen's mobile headquarters join hearts and raise great righteousness—who under Heaven would not look to the wind and respond!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Reaching Xiyang, he heard Huan had already encamped at Huayin and wished to return. Mobile Headquarters Left Director Cui Qian said, "Today the imperial house is overturned and the sovereign suffers dust; my lord ought to march day and night, attend the traveling court, then with Yuwen's mobile headquarters join hearts and raise great righteousness—who under Heaven would not look to the wind and respond!

sentences.zh: 至淅陽，聞歡已屯華陰，欲還，行台左丞崔謙曰：「今帝室顛覆，主上蒙塵，公宜倍道兼行，朝於行在，然後與宇文行台同心戮力，唱舉大義，天下孰不望風響應！

translations.literal: To abandon this and withdraw—I fear every man will lose cohesion; one lost moment, regret will not reach it!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, To abandon this and withdraw—I fear every man will lose cohesion; one lost moment, regret will not reach it!"

sentences.zh: 今捨此而退，恐人人解體，一失事機，後悔何及！

translations.literal: Sheng could not use the advice and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng could not use the advice and returned, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」勝不能用，遂還。

translations.literal: Huan withdrew to camp at Hedong, sent Mobile Headquarters Chief Clerk Xue Yu to hold Tongguan, Grand Commander Kudi Wen to hold Fengling, built a city on the west bank of Puban Ford, made Xue Shaozong inspector of Huazhou to defend it, and had Gao Aocao act for Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan withdrew to camp at Hedong, dispatched Mobile Headquarters Chief Clerk Xue Yu to hold Tongguan, Grand Commander Kudi Wen to hold Fengling, built a city on the west bank of Puban Ford, made Xue Shaozong inspector of Huazhou to defend it, and had Gao Aocao act for Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 44歡退屯河東，使行台尚書長史薛瑜守潼關，大都督庫狄溫守封陵，築城於蒲津西岸，以薛紹宗為華州刺史，使守之，以高敖曹行豫州事。

translations.literal: From the time Huan left Jinyang until now he had sent forty memorials in all; the Wei sovereign answered none.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Huan left Jinyang until now he had dispatched forty memorials in all; the Wei sovereign answered none.

sentences.zh: 45歡自發晉陽，至是凡四十啟，魏主皆不報。

translations.literal: Huan then turned east, sent Mobile Headquarters Hou Jing and others to lead troops toward Jingzhou; the people of Jingzhou, Deng Dan and others, seized Yuan Ying to respond to Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan then turned east, dispatched Mobile Headquarters Hou Jing and others to lead troops toward Jingzhou; the people of Jingzhou, Deng Dan and others, seized Yuan Ying to respond to Jing.

sentences.zh: 歡乃東還，遣行台侯景等引兵向荊州，荊州民鄧誕等執元穎以應景。

translations.literal: When Heba Sheng arrived, Jing met him in counterattack; Sheng's army was defeated and he led several hundred horse to come over in flight.
translations.idiomatic: When Heba Sheng arrived, Jing met him in counterattack; Sheng's army was defeated and he commanded several hundred horse to come over in flight.

sentences.zh: 賀拔勝至，景逆擊之，勝兵敗，帥數百騎來奔。

translations.literal: While the Wei sovereign was at Luoyang, he secretly sent Inner-guard Supervisor Zhao Gang of Henan to summon Eastern Jingzhou inspector Feng Jingzhao to lead troops to aid; before troops could be sent the sovereign entered Guanxi.
translations.idiomatic: While the Wei sovereign was at Luoyang, he secretly dispatched Inner-guard Supervisor Zhao Gang of Henan to summon Eastern Jingzhou inspector Feng Jingzhao to lead troops to aid; before troops could be dispatched the sovereign entered Guanxi.

sentences.zh: 46魏主之在洛陽也，密遣閤內都督河南趙剛召東荊州刺史馮景昭帥兵入援，兵未及發，魏主西入關。

translations.literal: Jingzhao gathered civil and military officials of the province to debate which course to follow. Staff Member Feng Dahe asked to hold the province and await disposition from the north.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao gathered civil and military officials of the province to debate which course to follow. Staff Member Feng Dahe asked to hold the province and await disposition from the north, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 景昭集府中文武議所從，司馬馮道和請據州待北方處分。

translations.literal: Gang said, "My lord ought to urge troops to the traveling court."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Gang said, "My lord ought to urge troops to the traveling court."

sentences.zh: 剛曰：「公宜勒兵赴行在所。

translations.literal: After long silence no one else spoke.
translations.idiomatic: After long silence no one else spoke, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」久之，更無言者。

translations.literal: Gang threw his blade to the ground and said, "If my lord wishes to be a loyal minister, please behead Dahe; if you wish to follow the rebel, you may kill me at once!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Gang threw his blade to the ground and said, "If my lord wishes to be a loyal minister, please behead Dahe; if you wish to follow the rebel, you may kill me at once!"

sentences.zh: 剛抽刀投地曰：「公若欲為忠臣，請斬道和；

translations.literal: Jingzhao came to his senses and at once led his host to Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao came to his senses and immediately commanded his host to Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 如欲從賊，可速見殺！

translations.literal: Hou Jing led troops to press Xiangcheng; the people of Eastern Jingzhou, Yang Zuhuan and others, rose to respond, and with their host intercepted Jingzhao on the road. Jingzhao was defeated in battle and Gang perished among the Man.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing commanded troops to press Xiangcheng; the people of Eastern Jingzhou, Yang Zuhuan and others, rose to respond, and with their host intercepted Jingzhao on the road. Jingzhao was defeated in battle and Gang perished among the Man.

sentences.zh: 」景昭感悟，即帥眾赴關中。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Chancellor Huan reached Luoyang and again sent the monk Daorong to present a memorial to Emperor Xiaowu, saying, "If Your Majesty from afar bestows one edict permitting return to the capital at Luoyang, your servant will lead civil and military officials and sweep the palace clean.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Chancellor Huan reached Luoyang and again dispatched the monk Daorong to present a memorial to Emperor Xiaowu, saying, "If Your Majesty from afar bestows one edict permitting return to the capital at Luoyang, your servant will lead civil and military officials and sweep the palace clean.

sentences.zh: 侯景引兵逼穰城，東荊州民楊祖歡等起兵應之，以其眾邀景昭於路，景昭戰敗，剛沒蠻中。

translations.literal: If there is no day of return to the right, then the seven temples cannot be without a lord and the ten thousand states must have somewhere to turn; your servant would rather bear guilt toward Your Majesty than toward the altars of soil and grain."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If there is no day of return to the right, then the seven temples cannot be without a lord and the ten thousand states must have somewhere to turn; your servant would rather bear guilt toward Your Majesty than toward the altars of soil and grain."

sentences.zh: 47冬十月，丞相歡至洛陽，又遣僧道榮奉表於孝武帝曰：「陛下若遠賜一制，許還京洛，臣當帥勒文武，式清宮禁。

translations.literal: The emperor also did not answer.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign also did not answer.

sentences.zh: 若返正無日，則七廟不可無主，萬國須有所歸，臣寧負陛下，不負社稷。

translations.literal: Huan then assembled the hundred officials and elders to debate whom to enthrone.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan then assembled the hundred officials and elders to debate whom to enthrone.

sentences.zh: 」帝亦不答。

translations.literal: At that time Prince Dan of Qinghe already went in and out with imperial guards; Huan found it ugly and therefore pleaded that "since Xiaochang the imperial line has been out of order; under Yongan Emperor Wen was made an elder uncle in the temple, under Yongxi Emperor Xiaoming was moved to a side chamber—short reign and early death, the duty lies here."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Prince Dan of Qinghe already went in and out with imperial guards; Huan found it ugly and therefore pleaded that "since Xiaochang the imperial line has been out of order; under Yongan Emperor Wen became an elder uncle in the temple, under Yongxi Emperor Xiaoming was moved to a side chamber—short reign and early death, the duty lies here."

sentences.zh: 歡乃集百官耆老，議所立。

translations.literal: He then set up the heir of Qinghe, Shanjian, as emperor and said to Dan, "To enthrone the king, better enthrone the king's son."
translations.idiomatic: He then set up the heir of Qinghe, Shanjian, as emperor and told Dan, "To enthrone the king, better enthrone the king's son."

sentences.zh: 時清河王但出入已稱警蹕，歡丑之，乃托以「孝昌以來，昭穆失序，永安以孝文為伯考，永熙遷孝明於夾室，業喪祚短，職此之由。

translations.literal: Dan was ill at ease, fled south with light horse; Huan pursued and brought him back.
translations.idiomatic: Dan was ill at ease, fled south with light horse; Huan pursued and brought him back, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」遂立清河王世子善見為帝，謂但曰：「欲立王，不如立王之子。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Emperor Xiaojing took the throne in the northeast of the city at age eleven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Emperor Xiaojing took the throne in the northeast of the city at age eleven, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」但不自安，輕騎南走，歡追還之。

translations.literal: General amnesty; era name changed to Tianping.
translations.idiomatic: General amnesty; era name changed to Tianping, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，孝靜帝即位於城東北，時年十一。

translations.literal: Wei Yuwen Tai advanced to attack Tongguan, beheaded Xue Yu, captured seven thousand of his troops, returned to Chang'an, and was advanced to Grand Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuwen Tai advanced to attack Tongguan, beheaded Xue Yu, took seven thousand of his troops, returned to Chang'an, and was advanced to Grand Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元天平。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Mobile Headquarters Xue Xiuyi and others crossed the river and held Yangshi Rampart;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Eastern Wei Mobile Headquarters Xue Xiuyi and others crossed the river and held Yangshi Rampart;

sentences.zh: 48魏宇文泰進軍攻潼關，斬薛瑜，虜其卒七千人，還長安，進位大丞相。

translations.literal: Wei Minister of Works staff officer Xue Duan of Hedong gathered village soldiers and drove off Eastern Wei troops, retaking Yangshi; Chancellor Tai sent Southern Fenzhou inspector Su Jingshu to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Minister of Works staff officer Xue Duan of Hedong gathered village soldiers and drove off Eastern Wei troops, retaking Yangshi; Chancellor Tai dispatched Southern Fenzhou inspector Su Jingshu to hold it.

sentences.zh: 東魏行台薛修義等度河據楊氏壁；

translations.literal: On dingmao, Faithful Martial General Yuan Qinghe was made Pacification of the North General and led a host to campaign against Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Faithful Martial General Yuan Qinghe became Pacification of the North General and commanded a host to campaign against Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 魏司空參軍河東薛端糾帥村民擊卻東魏兵，復取楊氏，丞相泰遣南汾州刺史蘇景恕鎮之。

translations.literal: Earlier, after Emperor Xiaowu of Wei had a rift with Chancellor Huan, Inspector Hou Yuan of Qizhou, Inspector Fan Zihu of Yanzhou, and Inspector Guiping of Qingzhou, Prince of Donglai, secretly linked together to watch how affairs would turn;
translations.idiomatic: Before this, after Emperor Xiaowu of Wei had a rift with Chancellor Huan, Inspector Hou Yuan of Qizhou, Inspector Fan Zihu of Yanzhou, and Inspector Guiping of Qingzhou, Prince of Donglai, secretly linked together to watch how affairs would turn;

sentences.zh: 49丁卯，以信武將軍元慶和為鎮北將軍，帥眾伐東魏。

translations.literal: Yuan also sent envoys to communicate with Huan's camp.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan also dispatched envoys to communicate with Huan's camp.

sentences.zh: 50初，魏孝武帝既與丞相歡有隙，齊州刺史侯淵、兗州刺史樊子鵠、青州刺史東萊王貴平陰相連結，以觀時變；

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu entered Guanxi, Prince Dan of Qinghe by provisional edict made Prince Xian of Ruyang inspector of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu entered Guanxi, Prince Dan of Qinghe by provisional edict made Prince Xian of Ruyang inspector of Qizhou, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 淵亦遣使通於歡所。

translations.literal: When Xian reached west of the city, Yuan did not admit him in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: When Xian reached west of the city, Yuan did not admit him in timely fashion, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 及孝武帝入關，清河王但承製，以汝陽王暹為齊州刺史。

translations.literal: City folk Liu Taofu and others secretly led Xian into the city; Yuan led horse and fled; wife, children, and retainers were all captured by Xian.
translations.idiomatic: City folk Liu Taofu and others secretly commanded Xian into the city; Yuan commanded horse and fled; wife, children, and retainers were all took by Xian.

sentences.zh: 暹至城西，淵不時納。

translations.literal: Marching to Guangli, he met a provisional edict appointing Yuan acting inspector of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Marching to Guangli, he met a provisional edict appointing Yuan acting inspector of Qingzhou, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 城民劉桃符等潛引暹入城，淵帥騎出走，妻子部曲悉為暹所虜。

translations.literal: Huan sent Yuan a letter: "Do not fear because your following is few and hesitate to go east. The people of Qi are shallow and follow profit; Qizhou could welcome the Prince of Ruyang—how could Qingzhou not open its gates and await you!"
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan dispatched Yuan a letter: "Do not fear since your following is few and hesitate to go east. The people of Qi are shallow and follow profit; Qizhou could welcome the Prince of Ruyang—how could Qingzhou not open its gates and await you!"

sentences.zh: 行及廣裡，會承製以淵行青州事。

translations.literal: Yuan then turned east again; Xian returned his wife, children, and retainers.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan then turned east again; Xian returned his wife, children, and retainers, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歡遺淵書曰：「卿勿以部曲單少，憚於東行，齊人澆薄，唯利是從，齊州尚能迎汝陽王，青州豈不能開門待卿也！

translations.literal: Guiping also would not accept replacement. Yuan raided Gaoyang commandery and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Guiping also would not accept replacement. Yuan raided Gaoyang commandery and took it, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 」淵乃復東，暹歸其妻子部曲。

translations.literal: He placed baggage in the city and himself led light horse to raid abroad.
translations.idiomatic: He placed baggage in the city and himself commanded light horse to raid abroad.

sentences.zh: 貴平亦不受代，淵襲高陽郡，克之。

translations.literal: Guiping had his heir lead troops to attack Gaoyang. Yuan by night hurried to Dongyang; seeing commandery folk bringing grain, he deceived them, saying, "Court troops have arrived and slaughter is nearly complete.
translations.idiomatic: Guiping had his heir lead troops to attack Gaoyang. Yuan by night hurried to Dongyang; seeing commandery folk bringing grain, he deceived them, saying, "Court troops have arrived and slaughter is nearly complete, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 置累重於城中，自帥輕騎游掠於外。

translations.literal: I am the heir's man, escaping back to the city—why do you still go!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, I am the heir's man, escaping back to the city—why do you still go!"

sentences.zh: 貴平使其世子帥眾攻高陽，淵夜趣東陽，見州民饋糧者，紿之曰：「台軍已至，殺戮殆盡。

translations.literal: Hearing this, all abandoned grain and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, all abandoned grain and fled, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 我，世子之人也，脫走還城，汝何為復往！

translations.literal: By dawn he again told travelers, "Court troops last night reached Gaoyang; I am the vanguard. Now I have come here—who knows where Lord Hou actually is!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, By dawn he again told travelers, "Court troops last night reached Gaoyang; I am the vanguard. Now I have come here—who knows where Lord Hou actually is!"

sentences.zh: 」聞者皆棄糧走。

translations.literal: The city folk were terrified and seized Guiping to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The city folk were terrified and seized Guiping to surrender, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 比曉，復謂行人曰：「台軍昨夜已至高陽，我是前鋒，今至此，不知侯公竟在何所！

translations.literal: On wuchen, Yuan beheaded Guiping and sent his head to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yuan beheaded Guiping and dispatched his head to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 」城民恟懼，遂執貴平出降。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Eastern Wei made Prince Chen of Zhao commandery Grand Marshal of War, Prince Tan of Xianyang Grand Tutor, Bearer of the Staff Gao Sheng Minister of Works, and Gao Aocao Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Eastern Wei made Prince Chen of Zhao commandery Grand Marshal of War, Prince Tan of Xianyang Grand Tutor, Bearer of the Staff Gao Sheng Minister of Works, and Gao Aocao Minister of Works, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，淵斬貴平，傳首洛陽。

translations.literal: Tan was a younger brother of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was a younger brother of Shu, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 51庚午，東魏以趙郡王諶為大司馬，咸陽王坦為太尉，開府儀同三司高盛為司徒，高敖曹為司空。

translations.literal: Chancellor Huan, because Luoyang pressed close to Western Wei on the west and neared Liang territory on the south, debated moving the capital to Ye; once the letter was issued, within three days they marched.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan, since Luoyang pressed close to Western Wei on the west and neared Liang territory on the south, debated moving the capital to Ye; once the letter was issued, within three days they marched.

sentences.zh: 坦，樹之弟也。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Eastern Wei sovereign left Luoyang; four hundred thousand households went on the road in distress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Eastern Wei sovereign left Luoyang; four hundred thousand households went on the road in distress, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 52丞相歡以洛陽西逼西魏，南近梁境，乃議遷鄴，書下三日即行。

translations.literal: They collected officials' horses; Masters of Writing assistants and above who were not in the entourage were all made to ride donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: They collected officials' horses; Masters of Writing assistants and above who were not in the entourage were all made to ride donkeys, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 丙子，東魏主發洛陽，四十萬戶狼狽就道。

translations.literal: Huan left a rear guard; when affairs were finished he returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan left a rear guard; when affairs were finished he returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 收百官馬，尚書丞郎已上非陪從者，盡令乘驢。

translations.literal: He changed Sizhou to Luozhou, made Chief of the Masters of Writing Yuan Bi inspector of Luozhou to hold Luoyang,
translations.idiomatic: In sum, He changed Sizhou to Luozhou, made Chief of the Masters of Writing Yuan Bi inspector of Luozhou to hold Luoyang,

sentences.zh: 歡留後部分，事畢，還晉陽。

translations.literal: made Mobile Headquarters Chief of the Masters of Writing Sima Ziru Left Vice Director, with Right Vice Director Gao Longzhi, Attendant Gao Yue, and Sun Teng remaining at Ye jointly to know court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: made Mobile Headquarters Chief of the Masters of Writing Sima Ziru Left Vice Director, with Right Vice Director Gao Longzhi, Attendant Gao Yue, and Sun Teng remaining at Ye jointly to know court affairs, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 改司州為洛州，以尚書令元弼為洛州刺史，鎮洛陽。

translations.literal: An edict said that because migrants' property was not yet established, one million three hundred thousand shi of grain was issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said that since migrants' property was not yet established, one million three hundred thousand shi of grain was issued to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 以行台尚書司馬子如為尚書左僕射，與右僕射高隆之、侍中高岳、孫騰留鄴，共知朝政。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Inspector Fan Zihu of Yanzhou held Xiaqiu to resist Eastern Wei; Southern Qingzhou inspector Daye Ba led his host to join him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Inspector Fan Zihu of Yanzhou held Xiaqiu to resist Eastern Wei; Southern Qingzhou inspector Daye Ba commanded his host to join him.

sentences.zh: 詔以遷民貲產未立，出粟一百三十萬石以賑之。

translations.literal: On gengyin the Eastern Wei sovereign reached Ye, dwelt in the northern city at the prefectural offices of Xiangzhou, changed the Xiangzhou inspector to Sizhou Governor and the Wei commandery administrator to Wei Yin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Eastern Wei sovereign reached Ye, dwelt in the northern city at the prefectural offices of Xiangzhou, changed the Xiangzhou inspector to Sizhou Governor and the Wei commandery administrator to Wei Yin, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 53十一月，兗州刺史樊子鵠據瑕丘以拒東魏，南青州刺史大野拔帥眾就之。

translations.literal: At that time, of the six-ward followers who went west with Emperor Xiaowu, not ten thousand remained; the rest all moved north and were given regular rations; spring and autumn cloth was bestowed for clothing. Beyond the regular tax, in places of good harvest silk and grain were converted to supply state use.

sentences.zh: 54庚寅，東魏主至鄴，居北城相州之廨，改相州刺史為司州牧，魏郡太守為魏尹。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wei Chancellor Tai sent Comrades of Honor Li Hu, Li Bi, and Zhao Gui to attack Cao Ni at Lingzhou.

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, Yuan Qinghe took Lixiang and held it.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, Yuan Qinghe took Lixiang and held it, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 55十二月，魏丞相泰遣儀同李虎、李弼、趙貴擊曹泥於靈州。

sentences.zh: 56閏月，元慶和克瀨鄉而據之。

translations.idiomatic: On guisi the emperor drank wine and met poison and died, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，帝飲酒，遇鴆而殂。

translations.idiomatic: Prince Shun of Puyang, in a side room weeping, told Tai, "Gao Huan drove off the former emperor and set up a young lord to monopolize power. Your Grace ought to do the opposite of what he did.

translations.literal: Guangping is young and immature—better to set up an elder lord and support him."

translations.idiomatic: Shun was a great-great-grandson of Su, the annals record.

translations.idiomatic: While Heba Sheng was at Jingzhou, he memorialized Military Guard General Dugu Xin as Grand Commander, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 殯孝武帝於草堂佛寺。

translations.idiomatic: The city folk secretly summoned Dugu Xin, the annals record.
